jobs.title: Software Designer C# / C++ / JAVA
jobs.description:
As a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA, you develop state-of-the-art application software for challenging high-tech projects.

In this role, you support our customers with user-friendly, high-quality, and cost-efficient application software. In the semiconductor, analytical, and medical equipment industry, within the Brainport region and beyond. Your software expertise plays a vital role in bringing high-tech solutions to life, like operating equipment, image and data analysis, process management and providing insight into large data sets.

What excites you as a Software Designer C# / C++ / JAVA?

From our office in Eindhoven and sometimes at our clients' premises you like to keep yourself busy with:

Demonstrating your creative skills during the conceptual phase of projects, translating requirements into innovative, clear and realistic concepts.
Acting as a bridge between architects and engineers from a technical perspective.
Assuming responsibility for a module / sub-system throughout the whole software development cycle.
Guiding and coaching a team of (senior) engineers.

Sounds good so far? We'd love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science.
You have 7+ years of experience in technical software development across different roles and (product) environments and / or projects
You have spent the last 4-5 years working within technical domains such as Semicon, Medical or Analytical.
You have experience with at least two of the following programming languages; C#, C++ or JAVA.
You have knowledge / experience with various development methods and techniques such as Design Patterns, UML, Agile and keep your professional knowledge up to date. You are looking for an environment where you can also apply these competences in your daily work.
It is an advantage if you can coach juniors, or are willing to learn more about coaching on the job.
You are a team player and strive towards the common goal.

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to buy an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from family festivals and sparkling Christmas parties, to inspiring knowledge sessions for the high-tech community.
Our Sioux office is located in a prime location in the heart of the Brainport region. At our main office you can enjoy lunch, sports, making music, and sharing your knowledge with colleagues in one of our Tech Labs.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

Go to testimonials >

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the US Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R.

730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require Sioux to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer - Financiële dienstverlening
jobs.description:
Stap als Junior Software Engineer in een wereld waar digitalisering nooit stilstaat. Waar financiële processen slimmer, sneller en efficiënter worden en waar jij het verschil maakt voor banken, verzekeraars en andere grote spelers in de financiële sector.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Junior Software Engineer bouw je aan de slimme digitale klantreizen van morgen. Je start met het ontwikkelen van software met goed gedefinieerde opdrachten. Je doet ervaring op en met de begeleiding van collega's ga je steeds grotere en meer complexe taken oppakken. Je ontwikkeling wordt gedreven door eigen interesses, ook op het gebied van frontend (Vue3, blazor) en backend (.NET). Er is ook ruimte voor DevOps.

Werk mee aan softwareplatforms die aansluiten op de systemen en processen van klanten bij hypotheek berekeningen, verzekeren en pensioenen.
Voer technische oplossingen door met behulp van Kubernetes, microservices, distributed systems en Azure.
Verdiep je in nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en wees nieuwsgierig, hiermee ga je de systemen begrijpen en kun je mee doen aan technische, maar ook inhoudelijke gesprekken.
Werk binnen een multidisciplinair team volgens Agile‑ en Scrum‑methodieken.
Draag bij aan het ontwikkelen van digitale klantreizen door technische problemen op te lossen en verbeteringen voor te stellen.

Kortom: jij bouwt mee aan slimme digitale klantreizen en ontwikkelt jezelf tot een software engineer van de toekomst.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Bij TJIP krijg je de ruimte om te groeien, te experimenteren en impact te maken binnen een mensgerichte organisatie waar plezier en professionaliteit samenkomen.

Je kunt rekenen op:

Een goed salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
Hybride werken, inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding.
Ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden met certificeringen en inspirerende sessies.
Een goede pensioenregeling en mogelijkheid tot deelname aan onze collectieve zorgverzekering.
Laptop van de zaak.
Een fijne werkplek in Delft, midden in het innovatiegebied van de TU.
Dagelijkse gezamenlijke lunch.

Wat breng jij mee?

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in informatica, software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting.
0 tot 2 jaar werkervaring als software engineer, óf relevante ervaring vanuit stages, bijbanen of projecten.
Basiskennis van programmeren in bijvoorbeeld .NET, JavaScript of TypeScript.
Interesse in moderne softwareontwikkelprincipes zoals Agile, Scrum, Microservices of Cloud-oplossingen.
Affiniteit met technieken zoals Domain Driven Design, Test Driven Development, Continious Delivery/Deployment en Containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) is een pré.
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
Een nieuwsgierige, flexibele en proactieve instelling. Jij wilt leren, bouwen en verder komen.

TJIP’er worden?

Solliciteer direct of neem contact op met Linda van der Meer en Ellis Slot via recruitment@tjip.com, via WhatsApp op 015 789 0732.
Binnen zeven dagen nemen we contact met je op. Bij enthousiasme plannen we twee gesprekken in: een kennismakingsgesprek en een technisch inhoudelijk gesprek.
We doen je een aanbod waar we allemaal blij van worden en kijken er naar uit jou te ontvangen als nieuwe TJIP’er.

Over TJIP

Sinds 1999 helpen wij organisaties die hun klanten financieel inzicht en vertrouwen willen bieden, zodat iedereen grip krijgt op zijn of haar financiële keuzes. Met slimme softwareoplossingen faciliteren wij het proces rondom financiële producten zoals hypotheken, verzekeringen, pensioenen en beleggingsproducten.

We zijn een ambitieuze organisatie die gelijke kansen biedt. We vieren diversiteit en zetten ons in voor een inclusieve omgeving voor alle collega’s. Als je gedreven bent en zin hebt om met ons mee te groeien, ben je hier op je plek. Want alles wat we doen, doen we graag samen én net even iets slimmer.

jobs.title: Web Architect & Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
At uniQure, we are delivering on the promise of gene therapy and delivering hope for patients facing urgent unmet medical needs. Every role in our organization carries profound purpose; whether you're in research, operations, access, or support, your contributions impact patients. We're seeking passionate professionals who thrive in high-stakes environments, uphold rigorous quality standards, and share our relentless commitment to transforming the lives of patients. Join us in making the impossible possible, where your expertise becomes a catalyst for life-changing treatments.

Position Overview

As Web Architect & Data Platform Engineer, you own the technical architecture of uniQure's websites and web applications and act as uniQure's data platform engineer. You do not need to build the websites yourself — external agencies handle the day-to-day build work — but you set the technical direction, act as the agencies' primary sparring partner on architecture, technology choices, and best practices, and hold them accountable for delivering maintainable, secure, and performant work. Once an agency's work is delivered, you review it, guide the agency toward proper development practices, and are hands-on enough to fix smaller issues yourself rather than waiting on a change request.

On the data side, you will develop and maintain uniQure's Data Platform, built on Microsoft Fabric, including its Lakehouse layers. You will build and maintain data pipelines using Spark, Python and SQL to turn data from across the business into reliable, reusable assets. Occasionally build Power BI reports directly for the business where needed.

Beyond the data platform and web architecture, you will act as a general application engineer within IT, working on data and process integration and scripting work across the organization. Building and maintaining data integration pipelines with an architectural mindset, connecting systems and data sources.

AI is a core part of this role. You will use AI tools to develop faster and more effectively across web, data and application engineering work. A solid understanding of how these AI tools and models actually work is important.

You will also review, refactor and harden code written by colleagues, agencies, vendors, or generated with AI, so that it is production ready and coherent with uniQure's existing architecture — this applies as much to the websites and portals delivered by external agencies as it does to internal data and integration work.

The Web Architect & Data Platform Engineer will be positioned in the IT team of uniQure. You will align with our Architects and our Application Management team to fulfill needs of our colleagues, and you will be the main internal point of contact for the external agencies responsible for building and maintaining uniQure's websites. Further you will have direct contact with the relevant business departments where the need for Data Analytics or web development comes from.

Key Result Areas (major Duties, Accountabilities And Responsibilities)

Build out the Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric, so uniQure's data is captured, structured, and usable in the Lakehouse.
Bring new data sources into Data Platform as new systems or business questions come up, without creating one-off, unmaintainable pipelines.
Step in on Power BI report building when a business team needs a hand getting a report off the ground.
Build and maintain the integrations that connect various internal systems. Take on integration, scripting, and automation work across IT, wherever a gap between systems needs bridging.
Bring an architectural view to how new applications and integrations fit into uniQure's existing systems, rather than solving each request in isolation.
Own the technical architecture and roadmap for uniQure's websites and web applications, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across every site built by external agencies.
Act as the primary technical sparring partner for uniQure's web development agencies, reviewing proposed architecture, technology stack, and implementation approach before and during development.
Manage and guide the agencies delivering website work, holding them to proper development practices — code quality, performance, accessibility, and security — and to uniQure's architectural standards.
Perform hands-on fixes and small changes to live websites once agency work is delivered, without needing to route every minor change back to the agency.
Use AI tools as part of daily development work, understanding how they work well enough to use them effectively, driving efficiency not only to your own work but company as a whole.
Review, refactor, and harden code written by colleagues, vendors, or AI tools before it reaches production.
Act as the technical point of contact for external suppliers on integration, portal, and website work, checking their delivery is sound and fits uniQure's architecture.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience with Python, SQL, JS, and modern web technologies (e.g. HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks).
Experience with, or strong interest in, data engineering and integrations.
A strong, hands-on background in full-stack web development and web architecture, with the ability to evaluate, challenge, and guide the technical choices made by external agencies.
Experience managing or closely directing external agencies or vendors on website or software development projects.
Clear problem-solving skills and an architectural way of thinking about how systems connect.
Experience in an international organization.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, or other cloud data platforms (Azure, Databricks, Synapse).
Power BI report building experience.
Experience with Workato, or similar tools, for integrations.
Broader Azure experience beyond Fabric (e.g. Azure DevOps, App Services, Storage).
Familiarity with using AI coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude Code) in real development work.
Experience reviewing code from others, including vendors or external developers.
Experience with content management systems (e.g. WordPress, Umbraco, Sitecore) or headless CMS/website hosting platforms.
Familiarity with web performance, SEO, accessibility (WCAG), and security best practices (e.g. OWASP) for public-facing websites.
Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices for web application delivery.
Five or more years of experience in IT and business, Pharmaceutical or Biotech industry.
Excellent analytical, strategic conceptual thinking, and execution skills.
Well organized and detail oriented.
Ability to multi-task.
Experience managing SoX and/or GxP compliant systems

jobs.description:
Senior / Principal Controls & Software Engineer | Eindhoven, Netherlands - fully employed (perm)

This is a senior, strategic role for an experienced engineer who can define scalable and compliant solutions while remaining close enough to the technology to guide implementation, integration and validation.

The role

You will lead the architecture, development and implementation of control systems, embedded software and manufacturing applications. You will act as a technical authority across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, IT, Supply Chain and external technology partners.

The role will focus on building reliable, secure and compliant systems that support manufacturing scale-up, technology transfer and future commercial growth.

Key responsibilities

Define and govern the long-term controls, automation and software architecture roadmap.
Lead the design and development of PLC, SCADA, HMI, embedded software and industrial control solutions.
Establish scalable, modular and standardised software and automation architectures.
Act as the technical authority for controls, automation, manufacturing software and systems integration.
Define technical standards, system requirements, design specifications and software development practices.
Lead software verification, validation and Computerised System Validation activities.
Ensure systems comply with GMP, GAMP5, data integrity and electronic-record requirements.
Support manufacturing scale-up, technology transfer and the transition from development into commercial production.
Drive integration across manufacturing systems, MES, data platforms, cloud services and business applications.
Develop approaches to advanced process control, digitalisation, analytics and Industry 4.0.
Set standards for system reliability, lifecycle management, maintenance and OT cybersecurity.
Lead complex troubleshooting, root-cause investigations and continuous-improvement initiatives.
Provide technical leadership, mentoring and guidance to multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Manage technical relationships with equipment suppliers, automation vendors and systems integrators.
Support project planning, risk assessment, commissioning and validation.

Skills and expertise required

Master’s degree or PhD in Automation, Control Systems, Software, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
Significant experience in industrial automation, control systems and manufacturing software.
Strong experience with Siemens PLCs, Ignition SCADA, HMI systems and industrial control architectures.
Knowledge of PLC programming, debugging, industrial networks and system integration.
Practical experience leading automation projects from concept through implementation, commissioning and validation.
Strong understanding of CSV, software verification and validation, GMP, GAMP5 and data integrity.
Experience within a regulated manufacturing environment, such as medical devices, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology or a related sector.
Experience supporting manufacturing scale-up, technology transfer or process automation.
Knowledge of MES, historians, manufacturing data platforms and cloud or middleware integration.
Understanding of industrial cybersecurity, including IEC 62443 principles.
Experience defining technical standards and influencing engineering strategy across an organisation.
Experience managing automation vendors, equipment suppliers and systems integrators.

Leadership profile

The successful candidate will be:

A strategic thinker who can balance long-term architecture with practical delivery.
Confident acting as a technical authority and influencing stakeholders at all levels.
Comfortable translating complex technical issues for technical and non-technical audiences.
Highly analytical, organised and capable of managing multiple priorities.
Passionate about innovation, continuous improvement and engineering excellence.
An experienced mentor who can raise capability across engineering and manufacturing teams.

jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

About The Katwijk Site

This position starts with a 12-month contract, with the intention of offering a permanent contract based on mutual fit. (Dienstverband: tijdelijk met uitzicht op vast)

Eli Lilly is investing €2.6 billion in a new state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Katwijk, Netherlands. This facility will produce oral medicines for cardiometabolic health, neuroscience, oncology, and immunology, incorporating next-generation manufacturing technologies including dock-to-dock automation, paperless manufacturing, and process analytical technology while achieving carbon neutrality and zero waste to landfills.

Position Overview

The Automation Data Systems Engineer supports the Aveva PI based Data Historian and other data systems at the Katwijk site. This role ensures the reliability, compliance, and continuous performance of the automation data systems from site startup through steady-state operations. 

During the design and delivery of the project this role will be integrated into the global automation team and then transition fully to a site-based process team position.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with Corporate Automation, Automation Integrators, and Global Facilities delivery to design, install, and qualify the site Aveva PI based Data Historian and other data systems.
System Administration ownership of these data platforms post-delivery including user access controls, life cycle management, process improvements, data management, and system maintenance.
Manage and own the system security including data integrity.
Perform audits and periodic assessments of the data systems to ensure compliance with Global Quality and Engineering Standards.
Lead the management and growth of the data platforms and support of manufacturing process teams as new systems are added to the facility.
Partner with Corporate Automation, Information Technology, and Information Security for global initiatives and life cycle management.
Develop site procedures that will govern the Data Historian and other data systems.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related science field
Professional fluency in English

Experience/Technical Knowledge

5+ years in automation
5+ years in pharmaceutical or other regulated industries
Knowledge of GMPs, regulatory requirements, computer system validation.
3+ years of experience in Aveva PI Data Historian administration including hardware design, software integration, and system procedures.
Experience in Microsoft operating systems, virtual environments, and networking.
Experience in ISA S95 Manufacturing Enterprise IT/Automation integration principles.
Experience in managing IT/OT platforms.

Additional Skills/Preferences

Experience in IT Infrastructure and Networking
Experience in Citrix Application publishing
Experience in virtual environments (VMware)
Experience in manufacturing connectivity software (i.e., OPC Server such as Kepware, Matrikon)
Experience in relational enterprise databases (i.e., SQL Server).

Interpersonal Skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills for internal customers, business partners, and leadership
Ability to work with minimal supervision, manage competing priorities, and drive results in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Ability to collaborate with others.
Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and organisational skills.

On-site Requirement

This is 100% full-time on-site role

Travel Requirements

We typically expect travel to be 10-20% during the design and delivery phase for engineering meetings, training, and job shadowing opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Windows Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Who You’ll Work With

This role sits within EMEA Client Engineering and reports to the Manager, Client Engineering. The engineer collaborates with regional and global Windows, endpoint, infrastructure, security, cloud, retail technology, and operations teams to build dependable platforms and raise engineering standards across Nike.

Who We Are Looking For

Nike is looking for a versatile senior engineer with broad Windows platform knowledge, strong software engineering fundamentals, and the judgment to work beyond a single technical specialty. The candidate combines hands-on engineering depth with curiosity across automation, endpoint management, infrastructure, cloud services, virtual desktop technologies, and operational reliability. They write maintainable code, understand modern delivery practices, and use automation to replace repetitive manual work. Just as importantly, they lead through example: setting expectations for quality, documentation, testing, ownership, security, and collaboration. The right person is comfortable challenging established approaches constructively, creating clarity in ambiguous situations, and influencing technical direction without relying on formal authority. They enjoy sharing knowledge, reviewing the work of others, and helping a team become more consistent and effective. This role suits an engineer who wants room to shape their focus over time while remaining accountable for measurable business and technology outcomes.

Typically 7+ years of relevant experience in software, platform, endpoint, infrastructure, or systems engineering.
Strong Windows engineering experience, with working knowledge of endpoint management, identity, security, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
Demonstrated coding and automation capability using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Perl, or Java, together with Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with modern virtual desktop platforms, cloud technologies, Infrastructure as Code, observability, or enterprise-scale automation is strongly valued.

What You’ll Work On

You will engineer and modernize Windows platform services used across Nike, while helping the team establish consistent ways of working. You will combine software engineering, automation, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to improve security, reliability, scalability, and the employee experience.

You will design, build, automate, and improve enterprise-scale Windows platform capabilities across endpoint, infrastructure, cloud, and virtual desktop environments.
You will develop maintainable tools, services, scripts, and automation using sound software engineering practices, version control, testing, and peer review.
You will build and improve CI/CD pipelines that enable secure, reliable, observable, and repeatable delivery.
You will set the standard for engineering quality, documentation, operational readiness, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
You will lead technical investigations, architecture discussions, proofs of concept, and modernization initiatives that address complex business and technology challenges.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer (x|w|m) SCADA Connectivity
jobs.description:
Für den Bereich Biobrain Supervise suchen wir einen Senior Software Developer (x|w|m) SCADA Connectivity für die Sartorius Stedim Biotech GmbH.

In dieser zentralen Rolle gestaltest du die Konnektivität unserer SCADA Lösung und treibst deren Skalierung auf ein neues Level. Dabei bist du nicht nur in der Softwareentwicklung tätig, sondern arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Laborumgebungen, lernst verschiedenste Geräte kennen und integrierst diese in unsere Systemlandschaft. Gleichzeitig übernimmst du die technische Leitung für den Bereich SCADA Connectivity und gestaltest dessen Weiterentwicklung nachhaltig mit.

Der Job ist in Vollzeit mit einer 40 Std Woche zu besetzen und als Standorte kommen Göttingen oder Guxhagen (bei Kassel) in Frage.

Wachse mit uns – deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst und skalierst die Southbound Connectivity unserer SCADA Lösung und ermöglichst so die nahtlose Anbindung interner und externer Geräte
Die Nutzung fortschrittlicher SCADA Funktionalitäten (z. B. Soft-Sensoren, Kalkulationen, Rezeptsteuerung, Orchestrierung) treibst Du aktiv voran und bringst sie über eine wachsende Instrumentenbasis hinweg zum Einsatz
Integrationslücken auf Geräte-, Konfigurations- und Protokollebene erkennst Du frühzeitig und schließt diese sowohl konzeptionell als auch hands-on in der Implementierung
Du analysierst interne und externe Installationen, in denen Third-Party-Lösungen oder Workarounds eingesetzt werden, und überführst diese in belastbare, standardisierte Konzepte und Lösungen
Lösungen zur Umsetzung und Integration von Plug & Produce / Plug & Play Konzepten und Standards entwickelst Du eigenständig
Integrationskonzepte und Anforderungen übersetzt Du in klare Arbeitspakete für Entwicklungsteams
Je nach Ausprägung arbeitest Du selbstständig oder übernimmst die fachliche Führung eines kleinen Teams zur Umsetzung der Themen

Das bringst du mit

Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Ingenieurwesen, in der Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation zeichnet Dich aus
Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im SCADA- oder DCS-Umfeld
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der .NET Entwicklung bringst Du mit
Fundiertes Wissen über industrielle Kommunikationsstandards wie OPC UA, Feldbusse, Industrial Ethernet und REST-basierte Schnittstellen ist vorhanden
Erfahrung im Bereich Secure Communication konntest Du bereits sammeln
Ein sehr gutes Verständnis von semantischem Plug & Play rundet Dein Profil ab
Kenntnisse relevanter Regularien und Standards wie GAMP und ISA 88 sind von Vorteil
Du hast Erfahrung in der technischen Projektleitung sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams
Agile Arbeitsweisen (Scrum, SAFe) sind Dir vertraut oder interessieren Dich
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse bringst Du mit, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Deine Benefits

Als weltweit wachsendes Life-Science-Unternehmen, das im MDAX und TecDAX notiert ist, bietet Sartorius eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen:

Raum für deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung: Mentoring, Leadership-Programme, Talent-Gespräche, internes Seminar-Angebot, Coaching für Führungskräfte
Arbeite in deinem Rhythmus: Home Office-Möglichkeiten, Gleitzeit, flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung, Sabbaticals
Großer, moderner Campus: Open Space-Büros, Terrassen, Betriebsrestaurant mit vegetarischen und veganen Optionen, gemütliches, italienisches Bistro mit Eisverkauf, Fitness-Studio und Kita
Von Anfang an mitgestalten: Umfassendes Onboarding inklusive Online-Plattform – schon vor dem Einstieg, Workshops, „Buddy“ als Ansprechpartnerin bzw. Ansprechpartner
Mobilitätsvorteile: Auto-Leasing, Bike-Leasing, großes kostenloses Parkhaus, gute Busanbindungen
Internes Vernetzen: Communities zu zahlreichen Themen, wie Coaching, agiles Arbeiten und Yoga, Business Women Netzwerk

Wir fördern Vielfalt und Inklusion und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Nationalitäten, Geschlechter, sexuellen Orientierungen, Religionen, Altersgruppen, Behinderungen und kulturellen Hintergründe.

About Sartorius

Sartorius is part of the solution in the fight against cancer, dementia, and many other diseases. Our technologies help translate scientific discoveries into real-world medicine faster, so that new therapeutics can reach patients worldwide.

We look for ambitious team players and creative minds, who want to contribute to this goal and advance their careers in a dynamic global environment.

Join our global team and become part of the solution. We are looking forward to receiving your application.

Technische Führung, starke Teams und verlässliche Produktentwicklung

Unser Mandant entwickelt geschäftskritische Softwarelösungen für den digitalen Handel. Die Anwendungen unterstützen mehr als 50.000 Unternehmen bei der Steuerung ihrer Warenwirtschaft sowie bei der Anbindung von Onlineshops und digitalen Marktplätzen.
Für die Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines Softwareentwicklungsteams suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die technisches Verständnis, moderne Mitarbeiterführung und einen ausgeprägten Blick für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung verbindet.
Als Engineering Manager schaffen Sie die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass aus Produktideen zuverlässige Softwarelösungen entstehen. Sie geben Ihrem Team Orientierung, fördern eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und sorgen gemeinsam mit Product Management, Tech Leads und Architektur für klare Prioritäten und realistische Ziele.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie übernehmen die disziplinarische Führung eines Entwicklungsteams und begleiten Ihre Mitarbeitenden durch regelmäßiges Feedback, Coaching und individuelle Entwicklungsmaßnahmen. Darüber hinaus wirken Sie an der Gewinnung und erfolgreichen Einarbeitung neuer Teammitglieder mit.
Gemeinsam mit dem Product Management übersetzen Sie Produktziele in umsetzbare Vorhaben und sorgen für klare Anforderungen, sinnvolle Prioritäten und eine realistische Planung.
Sie tragen Verantwortung für die verlässliche Umsetzung vereinbarter Ziele. Dabei schaffen Sie Transparenz über Fortschritte, erkennen Risiken oder Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig und unterstützen das Team bei deren Lösung.
Sie gestalten die operativen Entwicklungsabläufe - von Refinements und Sprintplanungen bis zur laufenden Steuerung von Kapazitäten, Qualität und technischen Themen.
Aufgrund Ihrer eigenen Entwicklungserfahrung können Sie technische Zusammenhänge fundiert beurteilen, Lösungsansätze kritisch begleiten und sich mit Entwicklern, Tech Leads und Architekten auf Augenhöhe austauschen.
Sie fördern den Wissensaustausch und eine konstruktive Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Teams sowie über Standorte und Fachbereiche hinweg.
KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge setzen Sie reflektiert im Arbeitsalltag ein und unterstützen Ihr Team dabei, neue Möglichkeiten sinnvoll in Entwicklung, Review und Delivery zu integrieren.

Ihr Profil

Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung oder Koordination eines Softwareentwicklungsteams, beispielsweise als Engineering Manager, Development Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
Sie bringen mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in C# und dem .NET-Umfeld mit.
Sie verbinden einen wertschätzenden Führungsstil mit der Fähigkeit, klare Erwartungen zu formulieren, Entscheidungen zu treffen und auch anspruchsvolle Themen konstruktiv anzusprechen.
Sie verstehen moderne Softwareentwicklungsprozesse und haben bereits Verantwortung für Planungen, Releases oder die zuverlässige Umsetzung technischer Vorhaben übernommen.
Auch in komplexen oder über längere Zeit gewachsenen Systemlandschaften behalten Sie den Überblick und können technische sowie organisatorische Zusammenhänge einordnen.
Sie interessieren sich für die Prozesse hinter dem Produkt und möchten verstehen, wie die entwickelte Software im Arbeitsalltag der Kunden eingesetzt wird.
Im Umgang mit Veränderungen, konkurrierenden Anforderungen und begrenzten Ressourcen handeln Sie strukturiert und pragmatisch.
Sie sind offen für KI-basierte Entwicklungswerkzeuge und moderne Engineering-Ansätze.
Für die Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld verfügen Sie über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbungsbearbeitung

Vielen Dank für Ihr Interesse an der ausgeschriebenen Position.
Falls Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Eingang Ihrer Bewerbung keine Rückmeldung von uns erhalten, bedeutet dies leider, dass wir Ihre Bewerbung für den aktuellen Auswahlprozess nicht weiterverfolgen konnten. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II - C# for UI/UX Development (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Overview

Are you a passionate software developer who wants to create value, someone who is eager to push boundaries to constantly improve the product you are working on? If you are excited about user interaction and user interface development and you enjoy working in a diverse, fun, caring, and progressive environment, come join us in our mission of developing the leading 3D reconstruction software worldwide. You will work with an innovative team to provide a solution that allows users to unlock the full value of 3D surface data. For you, clean and efficient code means building the base for future success and frequent learning is essential to your professional and personal growth.

We are on a mission to develop cutting-edge software solutions that empower users to harness the full potential of 3D data. You'll have the opportunity to work with a diverse group of talented individuals who are committed to pushing boundaries and driving advancements in the geospatial industry. Together, we create software that meets the needs of our users and contributes to social and environmental progress.

Join us, and be part of a culture that values curiosity, growth, and collaboration. Your expertise will help shape the future of our products and the experiences of our growing community of users. Let's embark on this exciting journey together!

What We Offer

Responsibility and impact
Passionate and supportive working culture
Flat hierarchies
Emphasis on team and personal growth through personal coaching and staff development events
Strong focus on company culture: appreciative, compassionate communication, enabling and embracing diversity
High-profile team that is driven by the pursuit of excellent results
Active ambition to become a technology leader in 3D reconstruction technology
Well-appointed office environment and equipment in the center of Stuttgart
Part of Esri, a global organization based in California focused on GIS and spatial analytics to enable global change
Attractive compensation including benefits like public transport, leased e-bikes, and fitness

Who We Are

We are an international team of young and enthusiastic individuals passionate about creating professional photogrammetry software and providing value for our customers. Embracing a high diversity of skills and cultures, curiosity and an urge for excellence drive us. Municipalities and leading companies in the mapping industry use our unique technology for countrywide data production. We have built a strong reputation in the market for us, this is just the beginning. Facing an evolving market and many fascinating technological challenges, we need your expertise to help us reach the next level. 

The Esri R&D center-Stuttgart develops the software technology Reality Engine, which is used worldwide to reconstruct 3D surface models from images and lidar. As one of the leading solutions in this domain, it focuses on high accuracy and large-scale applications such as aerial mapping of entire cities and countries. The resulting data empowers various applications in areas such as smart cities, infrastructure, 5G planning, change detection, environment monitoring, cadaster mapping, or VR.

Responsibilities

Build UI components using xaml
Build User Experiences to process, visualize, and share large 3D data models
Collaborate on implementation designs with team members and across other teams
Contribute to unit tests that back the quality of the development
Work closely with product engineers to innovate and develop based on our Reality Engine

Requirements

2+ years of industry experience in software development using C#
Familiarity with MVVM and xaml
Passion for desktop UI/UX development
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Proven ability to build and deliver quality software in a team environment
Effective time management and organizational skills
Bachelor's degree in GIS, geography, engineering, computer science, math, or related field
Existing work authorization for Germany

Recommended Qualifications

Experience with Geospatial software, specifically Esri’s ArcGIS platform
Master's degree in GIS, geography, engineering, computer science, math, or related field

At Esri, diversity is more than just a word on a map. When employees of different experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and cultures come together, we are more innovative and ultimately a better place to work. We believe in having a diverse workforce that is unified under our mission of creating positive global change. We understand that diversity, equity, and inclusion is not a destination but an ongoing process. We are committed to the continuation of learning, growing, and changing our workplace so every employee can contribute to their life’s best work. Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen einen engagierten Software Developer mit AI-Fokus (m/w/d), der mit uns die nächste Generation unserer Logistik-Plattform mitgestaltet – mit modernem .NET, einem starken Team und einer klaren Vision für den Einsatz von KI.

Wir sind ein junges Tech-Unternehmen und entwickeln eine innovative Softwarelösung für die Logistik. Unser Ziel: Mehrweglösungen so einfach wie Einweg machen und damit einen der nervigsten Prozesse der Branche optimieren – während wir gleichzeitig den CO₂-Fußabdruck der Logistik deutlich reduzieren.

In dieser Rolle bringst du KI dort ein, wo sie wirklich Wert schafft: in unserem Produkt für unsere Kunden und in unseren Workflows als Team. Du wirst AI-basierte Features konzipieren und umsetzen – und gleichzeitig unsere Entwicklungsprozesse mit modernen AI-Tools effizienter machen.

Aufgaben

AI-Features im Produkt:
Du konzipierst und implementierst KI-gestützte Features in unserem SaaS-Produkt – von LLM-Integrationen über RAG-Anwendungen bis hin zu intelligenten Automatisierungen.

AI-Strategie mitgestalten:
Du identifizierst gemeinsam mit Product, Sales, Customer Success und anderen Bereichen, wo KI in unserem Unternehmen echten Mehrwert schaffen kann – und setzt die vielversprechendsten Ideen um.

AI-Architektur & Tech-Entscheidungen:
Du triffst fundierte Entscheidungen darüber, welche Modelle, Frameworks und Patterns (z.B. Function Calling, Retrieval, Agenten) für welche Use Cases sinnvoll sind – und behältst dabei Kosten, Performance und Wartbarkeit im Blick.

Workflow-Optimierung mit KI:
Du nutzt AI-Tools aktiv in deinem Entwicklungsalltag (z.B. GitHub Copilot, Claude) und bringst Ideen ein, wie wir als gesamtes Team effizienter werden – von Engineering über Sales bis Support.

Prototyping & Validierung:
Du baust schnell Prototypen, um neue AI-Ideen zu testen, und entscheidest gemeinsam mit dem Team, welche davon es in die Produktion schaffen.

Wissenstransfer:
Du teilst dein Wissen über KI-Trends, neue Modelle und Best Practices aktiv mit dem Team und hilfst dabei, unsere AI-Kompetenz als Unternehmen weiter auszubauen.

Zusammenarbeit:
Du arbeitest eng mit Product Management, den Entwicklerteams und anderen Abteilungen zusammen, um aus echten Problemen smarte AI-Lösungen zu machen.

Qualifikation

Ausbildung & Hintergrund:
Du hast ein Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, eine vergleichbare Ausbildung oder entsprechende praktische Erfahrung.

AI-Erfahrung:
Du hast bereits mit LLM-APIs (z.B. Anthropic, Gemini) gearbeitet und verstehst Konzepte wie Prompt Engineering, Function Calling oder Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Entwicklungs-Know-how:
Du bist sicher in mindestens einer modernen Programmiersprache (idealerweise C# / .NET) und kannst eigenständig produktionsreife Features umsetzen.

Pragmatismus & Produktdenken:
Du erkennst, wo KI echten Mehrwert schafft und wo nicht. Du baust lieber schnell einen Prototyp zur Validierung, als monatelang die perfekte Lösung zu planen.

Kommunikation:
Du kannst technische Themen verständlich erklären – auch für nicht-technische Kolleg:innen aus Sales, Support oder Management.

Clean Code & Architektur:
Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für sauberen Code und moderne Softwarearchitekturen, auch wenn du im AI-Bereich oft im Prototyping-Modus arbeitest.

AI-Mindset:
Für dich ist KI weder Hype noch Bedrohung, sondern fester Bestandteil moderner Softwareentwicklung – und du willst dich und deine Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich mit neuen Technologien weiterentwickeln.

Teamgeist:
Du bringst dich aktiv in Meetings ein, denkst mit und teilst deine Ideen.

Benefits

Dein Buden-Buddy, unsere Welcome-Box sowie eine strukturierte Einführungsphase helfen dir dich schnell bei uns zurechtzufinden und bei uns anzukommen

Du erlebst eine positive Teamkultur durch regelmäßige Buden-Spieleabende, wöchentliche Coffee Dates, gemeinsame sportliche Aktivitäten (Firmenläufe, …), spannende Sommerevents, u.v.m.

Bei der Wahl deines Arbeitsstandorts sind wir flexibel und du entscheidest, ob du ins Büro kommen möchtest oder von Zuhause aus arbeiten möchtest

Wir wollen gemeinsam „groß“ werden und freuen uns, wenn du Teil der Reise bist und aktiv an der Entwicklung der Bude mitwirkst

Deine Arbeit hat einen nachhaltigen Impact, denn wir verkleinern den CO2-Fußabdruck der Logistik

30 Urlaubstage

Sollte selbstverständlich sein, haben wir aber auch: Kostenlose Getränke, Auswahl deiner Arbeitsgeräte, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

jobs.title: Engineering Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
About The Role

At Immowelt, part of the Aviv Group, you’ll work on one of Europe’s leading real estate platforms, serving over 50 million monthly users across both B2C and B2B journeys.

Our mission at Aviv is to unlock everyone’s perfect place, and at Immowelt, technology is central to delivering that at scale. This role offers the opportunity to lead a team in a product-driven, international environment, shaping architecture, engineering culture, and delivery practices while solving complex challenges in data, performance, and distributed systems.

We’re looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager / Lead Engineer with a strong technical foundation and leadership mindset to guide a cross-functional team. You’ll own team performance, predictable delivery, and engineering quality, while still contributing to architecture and code where it matters most.

You’ll report to the Engineering Director and work closely with Product, Design, and Analytics to drive meaningful business impact.

In This Role, You Will

Team Leadership & People Development

Lead and grow a high-performing engineering team (4–9 engineers), providing clear direction, focus, and context
Hire, mentor, and develop engineers through continuous feedback and performance conversations
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and engineering excellence
Ensure accountability for outcomes, quality, and predictable delivery

Delivery & Execution

Own end-to-end delivery, including planning, prioritisation, and dependency management
Proactively manage risks, remove blockers, and ensure timely execution
Partner with Product to define roadmaps and OKRs
Communicate progress, trade-offs, and outcomes to stakeholders

Technical Leadership (hands-on ~40%)

Contribute to architecture, prototypes, and critical code paths
Validate technical solutions across service design, integrations, and data models
Ensure alignment between technical initiatives and product priorities

Engineering Excellence

Continuously improve engineering practices (code reviews, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident management)
Build scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems following clean architecture principles
Drive performance optimisation and cost efficiency
Champion modern development practices, including AI-assisted workflows

The Skills You Bring

5+ years of software engineering experience
2+ years of people management experience with ownership of team outcomes
Proven track record of delivering high-quality software in a predictable way
Strong experience in system design and distributed architectures
Ability to balance process and pragmatism — improving quality without adding unnecessary complexity
Experience with modern cloud environments (AWS or similar), CI/CD, and containerisation
Familiarity with observability and operational excellence practices
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills (English required; German is a plus)
Curiosity and adaptability to quickly learn new technologies and domains

Our Tech Stack

Our primary stack includes .NET, C#, AWS (API Gateway, Lambda, SNS/SQS, DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate), Docker, GitHub, CircleCI, and Terraform.

Location & setup

Berlin, Germany
Cross-functional product team
Hands-on leadership role combining technical contribution and people management

Note From The Hiring Manager

You will lead one of the most technically ambitious initiatives in the company: a ground-up rebuild of the core platform domain that powers every listing across our classifieds. This is not an incremental improvement project, it is a full-scale architectural transformation from scratch, and you will be at the center of it.

Your team owns the foundation the entire business runs on. You will drive decisions affecting millions of data rows, shape services handling thousands of requests per second, and guide engineers through hard problems like sharded PostgreSQL at terabyte scale and high-throughput distributed systems.

This role is for a leader who wants real ownership, deep product domain involvement, and technical depth that most EM positions never get close to.

At AVIV, we are an equal opportunities employer and an organisation where everyone is welcomed to be their authentic selves. We strongly encourage individuals with visible and non-visible disabilities, all educational backgrounds, people from minority backgrounds, those from the LGBTQIA+ community and parents and carers to apply. If you need reasonable adjustments at any point in the application or interview process, or wish to discuss part time or flexible working requirements, please let us know.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example - she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

to strengthen our team.
At NexWafe, we are redefining how silicon wafers are manufactured. Our innovative epitaxial wafer technology reduces process steps, energy consumption, and CO₂ emissions, setting a new benchmark for sustainable photovoltaic production.
As a Senior Automation Software Engineer (f/m/d), you will support in advancing our Siemens-based automation platform and next-generation process control software. You will work at the intersection of industrial automation, software engineering, process control, and digitalization, developing scalable solutions that enable faster process development and improved manufacturing performance.

Join our international team and help drive the transition toward a more sustainable energy future.

Your Mission

Develop and maintain Siemens PLC applications, reusable function blocks, and standardized control architectures for NexWafe's production equipment.
Design and implement workflow-driven process automation, recipe management, and orchestration systems using Node-RED or similar platforms.
Integrate instrumentation, machine equipment, industrial networks, and SCADA/MES systems into a reliable and scalable automation environment.
Develop industrial software applications, APIs, HMIs, dashboards, and analytics tools.
Collaborate closely with process engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate process requirements into robust and user-oriented automation solutions.
Support equipment commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization activities to ensure stable, efficient, and reliable production processes.

Your profile

Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, Software Engineering, or a comparable field.
At least 5 years of PLC programming experience, including TIA Portal and Structured Text.
Experience with industrial automation, machine control systems, and commissioning.
Proficiency in at least one modern language such as C#, Python, JavaScript, or C++.
Practical experience with industrial communication technologies such as OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus TCP, MQTT, or REST APIs.
A structured and solution-oriented working style combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills in interdisciplinary and international teams.
Fluent English language skills, both written and spoken. German language skills are a plus.
Experience with Node-RED, workflow engines, or process orchestration platforms.
Experience with Grafana or other visualization software tools, industrial data systems, and advanced analytics.
Experience with web technologies and modern software frameworks such as React or Angular.
Experience with Git and modern software development practices.
Willingness to occasionally travel within Germany and internationally for project and commissioning activities.

Why us?

A diverse team: Short decision-making processes, flat hierarchies and collaboration with experts from different areas await you.
A diverse and exciting job: A company that contributes to the commercialisation of environmentally friendly solar energy with a low carbon footprint.
Stability with a certain degree of flexibility: A permanent position with flexible working hours.

Healthy balance: Take your physical and mental health to the next level with an annual health budget and a HanseFit membership!
Expand your language skills: Optimise your career prospects with the language courses offered.

At NexWafe, we're striving to set a new standard for the future of photovoltaic wafer production. The need for efficient, affordable and cleanly produced solar technology has never been greater – we're rising to meet that challenge.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Advisor Audit
jobs.description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

📋 Your role as a (Senior) Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll help to elevate your team's technical standards by championing sustainable development, prioritising operational excellence, and fostering a quality-first mindset. You’ll strike a balance between ambitious technical goals and pragmatic delivery, ensuring that reliability, security, and long-term scalability are integral, not secondary.

The Engineering Manager shall ensure that the team's purpose and accountability are tightly integrated with the organisation's strategic objectives, creating an environment where engineers can dedicate their focus to high-value work, consistently shipping value early and often.

Whether engaging with the team, collaborating across the organisation, or in broader professional interactions, you’ll focus on building mutual understanding, aligning individuals around a shared purpose, establishing trust, and enabling action with empathy.

In joining a newly formed team, you’ll be joining a dynamic environment in which ambiguity is not a hurdle, but an opportunity. You’ll have the confidence to navigate evolving priorities and shifting landscapes with a forward-looking perspective, and convert uncertainty into focused action, leveraging the energy of change to drive innovation.

📍 Job located in Berlin, Copenhagen,

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Delivery: Own outcomes and help the team deliver what matters.
People: Build and grow a strong, motivated team.
Technical Leadership: Guide technical decisions and be accountable for the implementation: you own technical outcomes, without centralising every technical decision personally.
Architecture & DevOps: Bring strong technical judgement on testing, observability, incident response readiness, and security/privacy/data compliance ownership and embrace “you build it, you run it.”
Agile: Help the team find the ways of working that work best for them.
Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Design, EMs and the Domain Engineer.
Customer Focus: Keep customer needs at the heart of decisions.
AI: Use AI in practical ways to improve how we build software.

Your First 6–12 Months

0-3 Months

Form the team and build relationships.
Define the mission, vision and roadmap with the trio.
Set up the team for successful delivery.
Establish the team's ways of working.
Start AI adoption within the team.

3-6 Months

Deliver the first building blocks of the global accounting kernel.
Establish a sustainable delivery rhythm.
Move towards AI-native engineering practices.

6-12 months

Continue delivering and evolving the accounting kernel to 9+ europeen countries.
Build a strong, high-performing team.
Further embed AI-native engineering practices.

Senior EM Focus Only

Support other teams and domains.
Contribute to the wider engineering organisation.
Help set up or accelerate AI adoption across R&D.

🔎 About you

You're an experienced Engineering Manager who combines strong delivery, people leadership and technical capability
. You're comfortable with ambiguity, change and making decisions without having all the answers.

Must-Have Experience

2+ years Engineering Management experience, ideally with experience in a second EM role.
Strong technical background and ability to challenge technical decisions.
Full SDLC and DevOps experience: testing, observability, incident response readiness, and security/privacy/data compliance ownership - "you build it, you run it."
Strong and production-proven opinions on architecture, design, testing and cloud (AWS preferred).
Strong Delivery Management experience: you own the roadmap, steer timeline conversations on metrics, drive forecasting, balance feature work against technical improvements, operations and maintenance.
Strong People Leadership experience: run structured 1:1s, manage the career development, have direct performance conversations, establish an inclusive environment with high psychological safety.
Comfortable with ambiguity and change.
Strong Agile mindset, with experience in Kanban or similar.
Customer-focused and able to connect technical work to customer problems.
Active engagement with AI beyond experimentation - you have proven experience in using AI inside of software engineering/R&D. Youcan critically evaluate their impact
Discovery experience working with Product and Design.

Specific programming language experience such as TypeScript, React or Node.js is not mandatory.

Nice to Have

TDD and/or BDD experience.
Accounting or FinTech background.

💚 Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening call with Talent Acquisition (45 mins):
An initial conversation covering your background, motivations, expectations, and an overview of the role.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins):
A deep dive into your leadership journey, people management approach, and delivery execution.

5️⃣ Meet the Trio (30 mins):
A strategic alignment conversation with key leadership partners focusing on cross-functional collaboration.

6️⃣ Personality Assessment Feedback (30 mins):
A collaborative review of your workplace personality questionnaire to discuss communication preferences and working styles.

7️⃣ Meet the Team (30 mins):
An informal session with your future team members and peers to explore team cohesion, daily collaboration, and culture fit.

in our medical device team.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering physicians globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this position be exciting for you?

At AMBOSS, we build tools that help doctors and students make critical decisions impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. This position makes sure that our product is built, verified, and documented in a way that's compliant, trustworthy, and audit-ready. You'll work closely with engineering as an independent evaluator, setting the standard for what "done and compliant" means across our medical device software. Join a small, high-impact team ensuring our medical device software meets the regulatory standards needed to safely support healthcare professionals.

You Will

Working within a collaborative development team, you will deliver secure, high-quality applications across the full software lifecycle, using Microsoft Azure, C#/.NET, Angular and modern delivery pipelines. You will work closely with developers, testers and technical leads to translate backlog items into reliable code, maintain live solutions, resolve issues, and produce clear technical and end-user documentation.

jobs.description:
RLDatix (RLD) is on a mission to help raise the standard of care…everywhere. Trusted by over 10,000 healthcare organisations around the world, our solutions help improve health and care. Our applications ensure that patients receive the best and safest care while supporting the providers who deliver it.

Joining TeamRLD means being part of a global effort of over 2,000 team members in making a difference in healthcare…every day.

We're searching for a London-based Application Support Engineer to join our QCS Customer Operations team, so that we can continue delivering reliable, high-quality solutions that support health and social care providers across the UK. The Application Support Engineer will act as the Level 2 technical escalation point, resolving complex application issues, supporting platform integrations, and helping ensure the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of our products and services.

How You'll Spend Your Time

Resolve complex customer issues escalated from Level 1 Support, applying technical expertise and product knowledge to deliver effective solutions within agreed service levels.
Investigate and troubleshoot application, system, and integration issues, conducting root cause analysis and collaborating with Engineering teams to implement long-term fixes.
Monitor live applications, dashboards, and system alerts to proactively identify, diagnose, and resolve issues before they impact customers.
Support and maintain integrations across platforms including Salesforce, Pendo, Vonage, GoCardless, Stripe, and other business-critical systems to ensure service continuity and data integrity.
Create and maintain support documentation, troubleshooting guides, and operational playbooks to improve knowledge sharing and reduce recurring incidents.
Support release readiness activities, knowledge transfer initiatives, and continuous improvement projects to enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and system reliability.

What Kind of Things We're Most Interested In You Having

A minimum of 3 years' experience in Application Support, Technical Support, Software Development, or a similar technical role, including experience supporting SaaS or web-based applications.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with proven experience investigating complex technical issues and identifying root causes.
Working knowledge of C#, MVC, ASP.NET Web Forms, SQL, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, and CSS, alongside a solid understanding of full-stack application architecture.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Operations teams.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet SLAs, and maintain high standards of quality and accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.Experience with technologies such as Jira, Salesforce, MySQL, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), Cosmos DB, Auth0, Azure Storage Explorer, or similar platforms.
A sincere interest in using technology to improve healthcare and social care outcomes, alongside a proactive, customer-focused approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.

By enabling flexibility in how we work and prioritising employee well-being, we empower our team to do and be their best.

We're excited about using AI to accelerate and improve our work, while applying our expertise and judgement to ensure everything meets a high quality standard.
If you’re passionate about wanting to champion better testing (whether that’s new tools, technologies or ways of working) - we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll bring to Answer:

Designing bespoke Test Strategies to compliment technical solutions implemented using cloud technologies (K8s, Docker).
Building frontend automation frameworks using the latest open source test automation tools (such as Cypress and Playwright)
Building backend automation frameworks using the latest open source test automation tools (HttpClient/RestSharp/RestAssured (C#), RestAssured (Java), SuperTest/Jest (JavaScript))
Working in an agile (Scrum/Kanban) project environment utilising a test first approach which drives and creates a shared understanding of project requirements e.g. Shift Left, Example Mapping, BDD, 3 Amigos
Implementation of automated quality checks to run as part of a continuous integration environment (GitHub/ Azure DevOps / AWS Pipelines)
You should also have an enthusiasm for leveraging new AI technologies to enhance your workflow and improve outcomes

It would be great if you also had experience in some of these, but if not we’ll help you with them:

Test Consultancy experience e.g. working on customer site and advising on agile test strategy and best practices
Mentoring of junior testers and contributing to our test community
Knowledge and experience of non-functional testing e.g. Performance Testing (Locust, k6, JMeter), Accessibility Testing (WCAG 2.2, AXE) or Security Testing (OWASP top 10/ Snyk/ Grype)
Experience of Data/ETL Testing
Experienced in AI usage in test, whether through AI enabled frameworks such as UIPath or Vibium or using coding focused LLMs like Claude Code or Github Copilot to accelerate your work.

The perks of being @ Answer

We’re an Employee-Owned Company. After 12 months – through the Employee Ownership Trust you will be part of the ownership of Answer; a major factor in driving engagement, retention and growth for our people
Competitive salary
Flexible annual leave (buy/sell and carry forward)
Twice a year income-tax free bonus based on company performance - it’s a reward for being a part of our EOT journey
Continuous training and development - if you want to learn, we’ll provide the support you need
Flexible Pension - we match your own contributions up to 5%
A flexible Healthcare cash plan so you can fund the care you value most
A packed social calendar including; end of year party (partners invited) and Summer away days, monthly and quarterly company team socials.
Parking at Head Offices in central Leeds, plus Cycle2Work & Green Car Lease schemes to help get you here
The chance to give back – get involved nationally and regionally with partnerships to get people from different backgrounds into tech, as well as lots of charity and community events
Hybrid and flexible working – you can vary your working when and where you work, to allow you to collaborate better, feed your creativity, and take the time and space to focus when you need to

Diversity and Inclusion

At Answer we proudly embrace diversity and inclusion - we want to create a safe environment for everyone to bring their true selves to work.
We will do everything we can to support your application. If you require any adjustments to be made to your application (whether that’s support with our interview questions, adjusting how we interview, or financial support with our hiring process) then please speak to Lesley Waghorn, Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant ( lesley.waghorn@answerdigital.com )

A bit more about us.

Answer Digital is a highly successful digital transformation consultancy headquartered in Leeds. We’re a company on a fast growth trajectory with a reputation of delivering large-scale, operational critical solutions.
People are at the heart of everything we do - so much so we’re owned by our people. It sets us apart from most digital businesses you’ll meet and defines our culture and values. Our people are invested in everything we do, because we are invested in them.
Don't believe us? Well check out our glassdoor and here what our people have to say

Our Interview Process

We pride ourselves on having a fair but flexible recruitment process, we want to create a platform where you can show us your best. For us, keeping it simple means you can focus on understanding if our people, values and the work we do are right for you. Our typical process can be broken down into 3 stages;
Recruiter call:
This normally lasts 15-30 minutes. We will talk to you about Answer Digital, the type of work we do, and an overview of the role. We’ll ask you some questions about your current situation and why you’re interested in working here. Here, we’d advise asking any “people” questions, anything about our culture, career progression or approach to flexible working.
Skills based interview:
This interview will be with 2 people, normally from the team you’re applying to work with. We can do this stage remote or in person, whichever you’d prefer. This interview will involve questions around your experience, the skills you’ve gained and the work you’ve done. We’ll also ask questions about the role and challenges you might face and how you’d face them. Here, we’d recommend asking questions about the role, the day to day responsibilities and what life in the team is like.
Cultural/Value interview:
This interview will be with 2 of our Leadership team, either our Directors or Capability Leads. It will focus on our culture and values, talking about our values and what they mean to us as well as understanding what values are important to you and how you like to work. This interview is about making sure Answer is right for you, as much as the other way around. Here, we advise you to ask as many questions around our business model, our ambitious growth plans and anything to do with Answer as a business.

jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon Fusus is a cloud-based Real-Time Crime Center (RTCC) platform developed by Axon to enhance public safety operations through integrated situational awareness. It consolidates live video, sensor data, and analytics from diverse sources including body-worn cameras, drones, fixed surveillance, and Automated License Plate Recognition into a unified interface accessible via command centers or mobile devices. The platform supports features like real-time location mapping of officers and resources, AI-driven alerts, and live video streaming which empower officers with timely intelligence. The platform is open and supports interoperability with a wide range of third-party technologies, while community engagement tools facilitate collaboration with residents and businesses to share camera feeds and tips. By providing a comprehensive, real-time view of unfolding situations, Axon Fusus aids in faster decision-making, and improved public safety outcomes.

As a senior engineer on the Axon Alerts team, you’ll be directly responsible for the design, development and delivery of the Axon Alerts platform. The platform ensures the right people are notified about the right information at the right time. You will be responsible for the system which ingests events from a range of 1P and 3P devices sources, the process of enriching with additional metadata, applying rules to determine recipients, and delivering alerts across a range of channels. You’ll also be responsible for the guidance and mentorship of the other engineers on the team. Operational excellence processes, metrics and dashboards are at the heart of our promise to keep our systems running 99.999%, even when bad days happen and the system unusually spikes.

This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

Codal is an award-winning web design and development consultancy that helps enterprise organizations solve complex problems and accelerate growth through elegant, data-driven digital solutions. Our areas of expertise include application modernization, eCommerce, UX/UI design, product strategy, data analytics, and artificial intelligence.

Codal is looking for a Solutions Architect who can look at a client's technology landscape, understand what's working, what isn't, and chart a credible path forward. You'll design and defend end-to-end solutions across software, systems, data, AI, and DevOps, translating ambiguous business goals into architectures that are practical to build and easy to evolve.

This is a hands-on and client-facing role. You'll move between whiteboard sessions with client executives, deep technical design work, and hands-on prototyping to prove out an approach before committing a team to it. You're comfortable weighing cost, timeline, risk, and maintainability against each other, then making a recommendation and standing behind it.

We expect this role to embody Codal’s principles of mindful excellence, insatiable expertise, diverse intuition, data-led curiosity, and candid leadership in how you lead technically, mentor your team, and engage with clients.

Who You'll Be Working With

You'll work alongside client stakeholders, from engineering leads to executive sponsors, as well as Codal's project managers, designers, and delivery teams. You'll be involved from early discovery and pre-sales conversations through hands-on implementation and post-launch support.

Responsibilities

Assess a client's existing technology landscape (software, systems, data, and infrastructure) and rationalize the pros, cons, and risks of what's in place versus what's proposed.
Design end-to-end solution architectures spanning application, data, AI/ML, and DevOps concerns, and document them clearly enough for both engineers and executives to act on.
Present and defend architecture recommendations to client stakeholders, including technical leads and executive sponsors, with support from Codal's delivery and account teams.
Support discovery, technical planning, and pre-sales conversations, translating client goals and constraints into a scoped, deliverable technical approach.
Create and maintain architecture decision records that capture the trade-offs considered and the reasoning behind each major decision.
Guide engineering teams through implementation, staying hands-on where needed (prototyping, code review, unblocking hard technical problems) without holding up delivery.
Evaluate emerging tools, platforms, and AI capabilities, and bring forward recommendations that would meaningfully improve a client's solution or delivery speed.
Partner with DevOps, data, and engineering leads to align architecture with CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and data platform realities on the ground.
Mentor engineers and technical leads on architectural thinking, not just implementation, helping the broader team reason about systems, not just code.
Support planning, estimation, and risk management across the project lifecycle, flagging architectural risk early.

What You'll Need To Be Successful

9+ years of hands-on software or systems engineering experience, including experience designing and owning architecture for complex, client-facing solutions.
Understanding and ability to solve complex client problems that will impact client business.
Proven ability to evaluate an existing technology landscape and make a clear, defensible recommendation, including build-vs-buy and platform trade-offs.
Strong grounding across at least two of the following: application architecture, systems/infrastructure design, data architecture, AI/ML solutioning, and DevOps.
Comfort learning a new domain or stack quickly (just-in-time), with enough hands-on ability to validate an approach yourself rather than only directing others.
Experience presenting technical recommendations directly to clients, including non-technical and executive stakeholders.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern CI/CD practices.
Solid understanding of databases and data platforms (SQL, NoSQL, and analytics platforms such as BigQuery).
Clear, confident communication skills, and the judgment to know when to hold a position and when to adapt it.
The drive to learn, adapt, and apply to the ever changing technology landscape.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in a consulting or professional services environment, including supporting pre-sales, proposals, or client discovery.
Experience architecting solutions that incorporate AI/ML capabilities into existing products or platforms.
Experience leading architecture review boards or similar governance processes.
A track record of guiding teams through complex technical challenges and ambiguous requirements to a shipped outcome.
Certifications in a cloud platform or AI such as AWS Solution Architect or Claude Certified Architect

Need Another Reason to Hit the “Apply” Button?

Codal is a global agency with over 250 employees, and offices in the US, UK, Canada, and India.
We’re forward-thinking by design, building for the AI-driven era rather than reacting to it.
You’ll work with clients where Codal truly owns the solution outcome, not just a scope of work.

UK & Selected EMEA Locations – Remote | Hybrid for Cheltenham-based candidates -

£90,000 – £100,000
