VIQU are partnering with a global manufacturing organisation to recruit a Solution Architect – ERP & Engineering into a highly influential architecture role. As the dedicated ERP and Engineering Solution Architect within the business, you’ll shape the future direction of ERP, Supply Chain and Engineering platforms across an international estate, defining technology roadmaps, supporting major modernisation programmes and exploring how AI, Copilot and agent-based solutions can enhance core business processes.

Key Responsibilities of the Solution Architect – ERP & Engineering:

• Own and define the ERP platform strategy and roadmap, ensuring technology decisions align with wider business and enterprise architecture objectives.
• Provide architectural direction across ERP, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Engineering platforms within a complex global environment.
• Lead the architectural approach to ERP modernisation, including the evolution of JD Edwards and Microsoft Dynamics 365 alongside other enterprise platforms.
• Assess new technologies and features through evaluation, proof of concepts and roadmap development, including AI, Copilot and agent-based solutions.
• Translate complex business challenges into scalable, secure and sustainable technology solutions while promoting standardisation and minimising unnecessary customisation.
• Influence senior stakeholders and executives on architectural decisions, platform investments and the adoption of global technology standards.
• Provide architectural governance and technical oversight across multiple delivery teams, implementation partners and technology vendors.
• Support international transformation initiatives, with some travel to stakeholders, technology partners and business locations required.

Key Experience Required of the Solution Architect – ERP & Engineering:

• Expert-level ERP architecture experience, ideally with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or JD Edwards 9.2, although experience with other leading enterprise ERP platforms will be considered.
• Recent experience delivering ERP transformation, modernisation or implementation within a complex organisation.
• Strong Microsoft Azure architecture experience, with knowledge of cloud development, integration, security and software architecture best practice.
• Experience augmenting enterprise solutions with low-code, Copilot, AI or agent-led technologies.
• Previous experience operating as a lead consultant, ideally within a consultancy or systems integrator environment.

and a car allowance.

.NET Developer | C# .NET | Energy Trading | ETRM | Hybrid – London | £900 | Inside IR35 | 6-Month Rolling Contract

A leading global financial services organisation, providing liquidity, market access and infrastructure services across commodities, financial markets and foreign exchange, is looking to hire a C# .NET Developer
to join their Power & Gas Technology
team.

This C# .NET Developer
opportunity will see you playing a key role in the complete restructuring of a Front Office ETRM trading platform that supports a high-performing Energy Trading desk.
As a C# .NET Developer
, you will be responsible for redesigning and modernising a mission-critical C# .NET trading platform, transforming a legacy application into a scalable, low-latency, event-driven system capable of supporting multiple Front Office traders operating across Power, Gas and Emissions markets.

Working closely with traders, quants and technology teams, you will take ownership of the platform architecture, driving the full software development lifecycle from solution design through to implementation and deployment, while ensuring the platform remains resilient, deterministic and capable of handling real-time market events under volatile trading conditions.

The C# .NET Developer
will work within an Agile engineering team building modern trading applications using C# .NET 8
, Azure and on-premise technologies. You will be responsible for designing scalable event-driven solutions, implementing asynchronous messaging patterns, and delivering high-quality software that supports pricing, P&L, execution management and risk across the Front Office trading environment.

This C# .NET Developer
role offers the opportunity to work with technologies including .NET 8, C#, Azure, SQL Server, Kafka, Solace, LINQ, Entity Framework, Angular and Event-Driven Architecture
. As a C# .NET Developer
, you will contribute to the modernisation of a business-critical ETRM platform while helping shape the long-term technology strategy for one of the industry's leading trading businesses.

Previous experience delivering Front Office Energy Trading
, ETRM
or real-time trading platforms
is essential.

🗺️ Hybrid working – 3 days on site - London

📆 6-month rolling contract (extensions expected)

🚀 Start date: ASAP

C#, .NET 8, Azure, Kafka, Solace, SQL Server, LINQ, Entity Framework, Angular, Event-Driven Architecture

Strong C# .NET development experience building high-performance trading applications
Extensive experience with .NET 8
, C#, LINQ and Entity Framework

Experience designing low-latency, event-driven architectures using Kafka
, Solace
or similar messaging technologies

Previous experience within Energy Trading
, ETRM
, Commodities Trading or Financial Markets is essential

opportunity, please apply with your most recent CV or reach out to me directly on Alfie@virtuetech.io

Ciklum
is looking for a Solution Architect
to join our team full-time in Poland.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About The Role

As a Solution Architect, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Ciklum is building a team to work on various projects whose primary goal to improve and automate the customer’s business processes, reduce the time and effort required for various operations.

Client for this project is the largest professional services network in the world by revenue and number of professionals. Client provides audit, tax, consulting, enterprise risk, and financial advisory services worldwide.

Responsibilities

Identify key business stakeholders and establish communication with
Identify business goals and objectives
Gather primary functionality, quality characteristics of software behavior and given constraints
Elaborate business, information, and technology architectures mapping
An elaborate architecture vision that satisfies architecturally significant requirements, through trade-off analysis, proof of concept implementation, and benchmarking
Set up and manage architecture design and documentation processes
Document and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs to major stakeholders
Review and validate design decisions made by down streams and ensure they do satisfy the solution architecture vision

Requirements

Fluent English
Commercial experience in software development (more than 7 years)
Commercial experience in solution architecture design (more than 3 years)
Experience with data management, data integration, and data transformation approaches
Understanding of containerization and orchestration
Understanding SDLC processes and their reasoning
Experience with guiding software development, testing, deployment, and project management
Excellent knowledge in Computer Science, Computing Theory
Architectural & Design Patterns
Paradigm & Principles
Database theory
Code testing practices
Practical experience with
Microservices architecture
Cloud technologies (Microsoft Azure)
Azure DevOps
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
Azure Databricks
Azure Service Bus
DBMS
Microsoft SQL
MongoDB
.NET 10
Business skills:
Excellent client-facing, business consulting, and communication skills
Ability to efficiently communicate verbally and visually
Ability to explain and prove the differences, pros and cons of suggested design decisions
Ability to influence senior client decision makers
Develop long-lasting relationships with business and technical stakeholders
Leading and supporting medium to large size solution delivery projects
Analysis of business, product and technology requirements

Desirable

Certifications on:
Architecture framework (SEI, TOGAF, etc.)
Cloud providers (Microsoft Azure)
Delivery processes (SAFe, Agile, etc)
Experience with
Release Management tools & Configuration Management tools
Infrastructure as a code tools
Experience in Pre-sales, Proposal/Bid preparation
Databricks experience is a plus

Personal Skills

Ability to relate positively to and engage with a wide range of people
Strong self-motivation, reliable and flexible team-player. High attention to details
Always seeking to improve processes and suggest alternative better solutions
Be ready to embrace change, be flexible

What’s in it for you?

Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
Flexibility: Enjoy flexibility – full remote working possibilities
Care: We've got you covered with company-paid premium medical package through Luxmed
Benefits: Access the MyBenefit cafeteria platform, allowing you to choose perks that best suit your lifestyle and needs

About Us

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

With delivery centers in Wrocław and Gdańsk, our 300+ professionals in Poland drive forward-thinking solutions for global clients. Join a community where collaboration sparks innovation—and your impact reaches millions.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

Let us introduce you to the opportunity at EY GDS Poland, part of EY’s global integrated service delivery network.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Leads the delivery of solution or infrastructure development services for a large or more complex project, using strong technical capabilities and outstanding hands-on experience!

Skills And Attributes For Success

Advanced technical proficiency in designing, developing, and debugging solutions
Advanced knowledge of one or more of: C#/Java or Python
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, IT, Mathematics, or related field preferred

Significant relevant experience in either an internal or external software or platform engineering role, or similar
Technical knowledge and experience in delivering software / platform engineering solutions (depending on specialism), providing comprehensive technical advice and handling user requirements

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

, Java

,

Fullstack Developera, który wniesie doświadczenie w pracy zarówno po stronie backendu, jak i frontendzie. W przyszłych projektach możesz być zaangażowany/a w takie obszary jak:

jobs.title: Client Technology - Engineer - Architecture
jobs.description:
Client Technology - Engineering - Architecture

Location: Wrocław / Katowice - 2 days in office / 3 days remote

Let us introduce you to the opportunity at EY GDS Poland, part of EY’s global integrated service delivery network.

At EY, we’re all in shape for your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help build a better working world.

The opportunity

We are looking for a candidate who will be part of the Architecture team within the EY Client Technology’s Architecture Team. The candidate will be responsible for defining and delivering architectures and designs for business-critical global products and platforms, hosted in a variety of infrastructure/environments considering reusability, scalability and reliability in alignment with EY’s mission and strategy!

Your Key Responsibilities

Build relationships across the business to understand their requirements, strategy and help them build product/platform roadmaps, demonstrate architecture leadership to translate business requirements into architecture blueprints, as well as innovative and practical design (both high and low level).
Own the overall technology, architecture and design landscape of the product/platform from solutioning to delivery to adoption and sale phases.
Potentially lead a team of architects in a portfolio or large product, set the overall technology and architecture direction and own its end-to-end delivery in a lead architect’s capacity, along with providing constant architecture governance and guidance.
Solve complex problems in realms where solutions may not currently exist, necessitating the ideation and incubation of the new solutions/ways of working/technologies, technical feasibility and buy/build analysis, vendor product evaluations, proof of concepts (with hands-on) and presenting various options to the business with appropriate recommendations.
Work very closely with multi-disciplinary teams (e.g. engineering, platform, infosec) to deliver the envisioned architectures and design using optimized delivery approaches, in compliance to enterprise standards, practices, policies and guidelines.
Provide leadership in product delivery to build and consume reusable functional and technical assets. Identify, define and implement the reusable assets and standards.
Provide support to product and project managers in building the plans, forecast, estimations and costs for new as well as existing products/platforms, to build the appropriate balance between costs, risks and quality.
Provides coaching, mentoring and support to development teams during the delivery phase across the eco-system, frameworks and platforms. Ensure that the developed artifacts comply to envisioned architecture and design, expected quality, recommended standards/practices with code reviews and various levels of architecture, design and quality reviews.
Contribute to architecture and development standards/guidelines to promote optimization and consistency.
Have the ability to work across multiple projects with varied stakeholders. An architect sets architectural direction, builds consensus, mediates conflicts providing technical leadership and advisory services to the business. He/she anticipates needs and potential objections and helps to create an environment which solicits positive contributions from all participants.
Demonstrate good interpersonal communication and organizational skills that are required to operate as a leading member of global, distributed teams that deliver quality services and solutions.
Cultivate lasting relationships across business, IT and vendors / industry analysts to maintain insight into the broader enterprise as well as industry trends. Understand new trends and emerging technologies, and how they apply to EY. Evangelize and encourage the importance of technical quality, emerging technologies, sharing & experimentation across the org through mentoring, hackathons, communities etc.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Led and governed a global team of solution architects and technical architects, driving the technology and architecture landscape of large and complex portfolio of products/solutions/projects, achieving success in its implementation and adoption.
Architecture leadership skills, advanced understanding and practical experience of architecture role with proven track record in a complex, large-scale (team size in hundreds), global product/platform (user base in hundreds, thousands and more) ecosystem across the entire lifecycle from planning to delivery to support/operations and adoption. Proven ability to work with business as well as perform hands-on technology delivery work in architect’s capacity using various architecture and design tools.
Hands-on deep experience of one or more specialization of solution and technical architecture role e.g. application, infrastructure/cloud, integration, data and security architectures and successful delivery of functional as well as non-functional aspects of a product/platform, using native cloud, full-stack application, data, security, AI technologies, following Agile, DevSecOps and automation practices.
Expert-level skills in defining, designing and developing distributed and scalable products and platforms, using reusable domain-specific composable (micro) services running on containers on multi-platform/hybrid clouds (Microsoft Azure preferred) using the respective cloud IaaS/PaaS/SaaS services.
Expert-level skills in multiple application programming and scripting languages (JavaScript, .NET, Java, Python, C++, etc.), SQL and noSQL databases, Bigdata and its processing, Data analytics and Machine Learning, Industry’s recommended authentication/authorization technologies. Microsoft and Azure based technology skills are preferred.
Ability to adopt and relate new technologies to the set of problems we face at EY while adhering to security and other EY standards.
Understanding of business and organizational strategy and ability to communicate solutions, ideas, suggestions to business partners effectively and comprehensibly.
In-depth knowledge of various design patterns, and architectural styles (e.g., traditional application based as well as microservices and containers, event-driven, data streaming, data transformations and analytics)
Strong collaboration, analytical, interpersonal and communication abilities.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, Economics.
15+ years overall IT industry experience, with 5+ years in a solution or technical architect role using service and hosting solutions such as private/public cloud IaaS, PaaS and SaaS platforms.
Achieved one or more of the typical solution and technical architecture certifications e.g. Microsoft, MS Azure Certification, TOGAF, AWS Cloud Certified, Pivotal, CISSIP, Zachman, ITIL, Cisco, (ISC)2, CEH, SAFe, PMI, and SAP etc.
Thought leadership - presenting ideas, products, concept papers to varied audiences, building point of views and presenting them in industry forums/event.
Experience in designing and implementation of business use-cases using low-code/no-code, Generative AI, data reporting, data management and governance technologies, mobile applications, deep cloud security concepts.

What We Look For

We want people who are self-starters, who can take initiative and get things done. If you can think critically and creatively to solve problems, you will excel. You should be comfortable working with culturally diverse outsourced on/offshore team members which means you may need to work outside of the normal working hours in your time zone to partner with other Client Technology staff globally. Some travel may also be required, both domestic and international.

In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. Responsibilities

Do you have a passion for high-quality software? Do you enjoy breaking and taking things apart while trying to figure out what makes them work? Are you ready to put your skills to use by using some of the newest tools and technologies available? IGT, the leading slot game manufacturer, is seeking an enthusiastic Game SDET who is ready to apply their technical expertise and experience to achieve new levels of quality assurance to game production.

As a Game SDET, you will be working as part of an integrated team with software and test engineers, as well as many other disciplines within the company to assist in delivering the highest quality gaming software to the world.

Typical Day To Day Game SDET Tasks Include

Work closely with the software developers and test automation engineers to identify what needs to be tested in new or existing features.
Design, document and implement complex processes, tools, and programs using a wide variety of modern programming languages and technologies.
Test gaming software to ensure it meets required customer, functional, and regulatory and specification requirements.
Accurately monitor and communicate test execution results while consolidating, analyzing, and debugging them.
Proactively research and develop software tools and automation to support test plans.
Continuous build and auto-deployment research and development for IGT gaming machines.
Provide estimates for assigned work and guidance in estimation to other engineers as required.
Investigate regulatory and field issues/defects.
Perform ad hoc, black box and white box testing.

Participate application security program, including tool selection, policy enforcement, developer engagement, and risk reporting.
Own integration of AppSec tooling into CI/CD pipelines to enable scalable, developer-friendly security controls.
Provide architectural guidance and secure design recommendations during development planning.
Oversee deployment and tuning of tools for SAST, SCA, secrets management, IaC scanning, and DAST (e.g., Tenable Web App Scanning).

Collaborate with GRC/compliance teams to ensure alignment with relevant standards (e.g., OWASP, FedRAMP).
Mentor and support other AppSec engineers and champion a security-first development culture.
Evaluate IAST and runtime protections as part of continuous improvement efforts.
Develop KPIs to measure security posture and tooling efficacy.

Bachelors of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science required or equivalent.

Remote

Full-time / B2B
Lead / Principal

About The Role

We're hiring a DevOps Solution Architect on behalf of our client, a technology consulting company delivering DevOps, cloud, and security solutions across multiple international projects, to join their team.

You'll provide architectural leadership and technical oversight across several client engagements at once, working closely with Client Delivery Managers and Project Engineers on technical discovery, solution design, DevSecOps strategy, delivery reviews, and complex technical escalations.

This is a client-facing leadership role that blends solution architecture, DevSecOps, technical consulting, presales, mentoring, and delivery governance — not a traditional people-management position or a full-time engineering assignment on a single project.

Key Responsibilities

Lead technical discovery, assessments, and architecture workshops
Translate business requirements into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective cloud solutions
Design Azure, hybrid-cloud, DevSecOps, platform, networking, security, and operational architectures
Define technical approaches, implementation roadmaps, dependencies, assumptions, and risks
Prepare and validate technical backlogs, estimates, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans
Review architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, security controls, and key deliverables
Ensure solutions meet security, reliability, scalability, observability, compliance, and production-readiness requirements
Guide and mentor Project Engineers without taking over their day-to-day implementation ownership
Support engineers with complex technical decisions, blockers, and escalations
Participate in presales, proposal preparation, technical estimation, and client presentations
Act as a trusted technical advisor to CTOs, engineering teams, architects, and security stakeholders
Develop reusable reference architectures, Terraform modules, pipeline templates, standards, and delivery practices
Support technical interviews, onboarding, and knowledge-sharing activities
Identify modernization, automation, security, reliability, and cost-optimization opportunities

What We're Looking For

Must Have

Strong professional experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, Cloud, Platform Engineering, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering
Previous experience as a DevOps Architect, Cloud Architect, Solution Architect, Technical Lead, or similar senior technical role

As a Staff .NET Developer at Rebtel you will serve as the technical guardian and principal individual contributor for the entire Backend (BE) architecture and ecosystem. This role is crucial for ensuring the technical excellence, scalability, reliability, and security of all backend systems that power our core products and services. The Staff Software Engineer will operate at a high level of abstraction, influencing engineering practices across multiple teams while remaining hands-on in critical areas.

You’ll be actively involved in architectural decisions, contribute to technical discussions, and inspire your team to deliver clean, robust code.

Responsibilities And Tasks

Lead the design, development, and deployment of complex, high-throughput backend services and APIs, ensuring best-in-class performance and maintainability.
Drive architectural decisions and serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for BE-related challenges.
Establish and articulate a clear, ambitious long-term vision and technical roadmap for the evolution of the BE systems.
This includes planning for future growth, anticipating technological shifts, and driving the adoption of new technologies and patterns to maintain a competitive edge.
Act as the primary architect for major system initiatives, defining microservices boundaries, data models, integration patterns, and deployment strategies.
Proactively identify and resolve technical debt and architectural risks before they impact the business.
Mentor engineers, elevating the technical expertise and quality of engineering output across the organization.
Influence engineering standards and best practices for testing, performance tuning, and security across different development teams.

Requirements

Exceptional and proven proficiency in the .NET area, including extensive experience with C#, .NET Core/8+, and related frameworks (e.g., ASP. NET Core, Entity Framework Core).
Must demonstrate the ability to architect and build high-performance, fault-tolerant systems using the .NET stack.
Demonstrable architecting skills with a strong background in designing and implementing large-scale, distributed systems (e.g., microservices, event-driven architectures, serverless).
Expert knowledge of design patterns, domain-driven design (DDD), and SOLID principles.
Extensive experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and related services (e.g., managed databases, message queues, containerization).
Deep understanding of various database technologies (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling best practices for scalable applications.
System-Level Thinking: Ability to decompose complex problems into manageable components and evaluate trade-offs between different technical solutions (e.g., speed vs. stability, buy vs. build).
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, driving consensus on critical architectural decisions.

Why Rebtel?

Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.

This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.

Pension Plan
Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance

Discount on gym memberships
Bonus program
Extra parental pay
30 days annual vacation
Monday breakfasts
Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.

We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

From our office in central Stockholm, we help our user base of 1 million dual-culture people—predominantly from the global south—connect with and support their communities through affordable data-free international calling and mobile top-ups. With our app and online platform, we help dissolve the space between their worlds so they can live more connected lives.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer - Energy Management Systems
jobs.description:
Do you want to write backend code that actually matters, powering energy efficiency for thousands of buildings across Europe? Are you an experienced Java developer who takes end-to-end ownership, makes deliberate architectural choices, and wants real influence over a platform built on Azure and Kubernetes?

Then you might be the Senior Backend Developer our Mestro team in Stockholm is looking for!

As Part of the Department

We craft the vertical software of tomorrow, bringing sustainable impact to customers and society. At Mestro, we combine data-driven innovation with a genuine passion for energy efficiency and sustainability. As part of EG Group, we are a dedicated team of innovators and problem solvers who take responsibility for our contribution to our customers, each other, and the society we live in.

We are now looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join Mestro on a permanent, full-time basis, contributing to the continued development of the platform. This is a hybrid role with our Stockholm office as your base. You will combine days on site with the team and days working remotely.

Your Tasks: Design, Build, and Own the Backend

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will be one of the people the team relies on for the backend systems powering the Mestro platform. You will design and build new functionality, improve what we already have, and work closely with product owners, architects, and frontend developers to turn business goals into technical solutions that hold up over time.

You Will

Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs for the Mestro platform.
Drive architectural and technical decisions, and take responsibility for their consequences.
Deploy, monitor, and operate applications in Azure and Kubernetes. You build it, you run it.
Identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability issues.
Set the bar for code quality through well-tested code and constructive code reviews.
Break down complex and unclear requirements together with product owners and turn them into solutions that can be delivered.
Mentor colleagues and raise the level of the whole team, not just your own output.

Your Profile: An Experienced Developer Who Takes Ownership

You have enough experience to know that writing the code is rarely the hard part. You make pragmatic trade-offs, communicate clearly about risk and scope, and take ownership of your work all the way into production. You want to work in a small team where your opinion carries weight, and where you are expected to have one.

You Are The Ideal Candidate If You

Have 8-10 years of professional experience in backend development.
Have deep knowledge of Java, and solid experience with MS SQL and Azure.
Have hands-on experience building and running applications in Kubernetes.
Have a strong grasp of software architecture and distributed systems, including the trade-offs they involve.
Have experience mentoring developers and driving technical decisions in a team.
Communicate confidently in English, both in writing and in technical discussion.

Nice To Have

Experience designing and operating microservice architectures.
Strong CI/CD and DevOps practices: pipelines, infrastructure as code, and observability.
Experience with large data volumes, time series data, or integrations with external data sources.
Background in the energy management, proptech, or data analytics domain.

What's in it for you?

A product with real purpose. Mestro helps buildings across Europe cut energy waste, so your code has tangible impact.
Real technical influence. You will shape architecture and priorities, not just close tickets.
A modern tech stack: Java, Azure, Kubernetes, MS SQL.
Autonomy with support. We trust you to own your work, and we back you when you need it.
A hybrid setup with our Stockholm office as your base, and a collaborative, low-ego culture.
The stability and resources of EG Group behind a product team that still moves fast.
Room to grow, whether deeper into architecture, DevOps, or domain expertise in energy management.

Our Values

Lead the Industry — We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
Make it Happen — We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
Stronger Together — We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.

We look forward to hearing from you!

If you are interested in learning more before you apply, please contact Senior Manager Jimmy Persson jiper@eg.se or on +46 702 99 10 49. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.

At EG, we build software that makes a difference.

Our industry-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.

Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security. If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here.

Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.

Qurant is on a mission to make employee health more proactive, measurable and sustainable.

Through our health platform and close collaboration with HR and leadership teams, we help organisations spot early signs of ill health and build healthier workplaces. We are proud of our customer satisfaction and are growing our team to help even more companies make proactive health a natural part of working life.

Qurant is an independent company within the Capio Group.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Software Developer to join our growing product team.

You will work across our product: a Laravel-based web portal used by Swedish employers to manage employee absence and health, as well as a new mobile app currently in development.

We are a small team, which means no rigid “web person” or “mobile person” roles. We collaborate, learn from each other and pitch in where the product needs us. You will help build new features, improve performance and reliability, and make thoughtful improvements to an established codebase.

As we work with sensitive personal data, quality, security and good engineering practices matter a lot to us.

What you’ll do

Develop and maintain features across our web portal and mobile app
Work hands-on with PHP, Laravel, relational databases and integrations
Improve application and database performance, including queries and indexing
Navigate technical debt, legacy patterns and ongoing improvements with pragmatism
Collaborate on code reviews, technical decisions and product development
Work with Docker, CI/CD and cloud deployments
Learn new technologies and contribute wherever the team needs you

We think you’ll thrive here if you have

5+ years of experience building and maintaining production software
Strong experience with a server-rendered web framework, such as Laravel, Symfony, Rails, Django or ASP.NET Core
A genuine interest in working with PHP and Laravel day to day
Solid relational database skills, including query optimisation and performance troubleshooting
Experience working in existing codebases—not just greenfield projects
Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD and a major cloud platform such as Azure, AWS or GCP
A collaborative mindset and the confidence to pick up unfamiliar technologies
Professional fluency in English; Swedish is a strong advantage

Nice to have

Experience with any of the following is a bonus:

Flutter, React Native or native mobile development
GDPR or sensitive personal data in healthcare, finance or another regulated setting
Multi-tenant SaaS products
AI coding assistants and agentic workflows
Livewire, Alpine.js, Blade, Vue, React, TypeScript, Terraform, Kubernetes or PostgreSQL

For the technically curious (and the proud tech nerds), here’s our stack:

Laravel / PHP, Livewire 3, Alpine.js, Blade, Bootstrap 5 / SCSS, MySQL / MariaDB, Redis, Docker, GitHub Actions and Azure Container Apps with Bicep.

Our mobile app is built in Flutter. We also work with OAuth, webhooks, SFTP-based file flows and integrations such as Försäkringskassan. Some parts of the frontend still use jQuery—because real-life codebases are rarely built in a day.

What we offer

A meaningful role in a growing health-tech company
A collaborative team with plenty of room to influence both product and technology
The chance to work across web, mobile, cloud and integrations
Central Stockholm offices on Drottninggatan, with hybrid work options

How to apply

Want to help us build healthier workplaces across Sweden? We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible.

Start date: autumn or as agreed.

Job Title

Experienced Software Engineer – Imaging Tools & Test Automation

Job Description

Do you enjoy building the tools that other engineers depend on? Join our imaging laboratory team in Lund as an Experienced Software Engineer – Imaging Tools & Automation, and help shape the environment behind the best forensic image quality on the market.

Who is your future team?

You will join the imaging laboratory team in Lund, responsible for developing and maintaining the internal tools used by Axis imaging engineers. The team takes strong ownership of its service — a service that plays an essential role in delivering the best forensic image quality on the market.

You will belong to the software part of the group, working alongside colleagues on the hardware side.

What you'll do here as Experienced Software Engineer – Imaging Tools & Test Automation

This role exists to support our imaging engineers by maintaining and developing the frontend and backend of the imaging lab interface. The scope extends to any tooling or automation that improves the quality and efficiency of imaging development work.

Own and improve the Linux and Windows server environments that power our imaging labs
Develop and enhance the web-based tools our engineers rely on every day, both frontend and backend
Maintain, improve and automate our imaging tests, and develop new ones
Bring new hardware devices into the lab environment
Explore new ways to push the development of Axis cameras forward

This role suits someone who enjoys applying a wide skillset to real-world problems.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a creative problem-solver who takes pride in their work and understands what it means to deliver excellent service to internal users. You take responsibility for your own work and are comfortable finding your own way forward once you know where we are heading.

You bring natural curiosity and a genuine willingness to learn across a wide range of topics — from software to the physics of imaging and optics. You like getting hands-on and figuring out how things work. Building a working understanding of digital imaging will help you collaborate effectively with our imaging engineers, and it is an area where you can keep growing.

We'd love to hear that you have:

A bachelor's or master's degree in computer engineering, or equivalent experience
Some years of relevant work experience
A comparatively wide skillset, or the willingness and demonstrated ability to build one
Experience working in both Linux and Windows environments
Experience using Python for system integration
Working knowledge of Git and Gerrit
A service-oriented approach to supporting colleagues

Bonus points for:

Hands-on experience connecting hardware and software — whether through work, studies, or projects of your own. Tell us what you've built and tinkered with
Familiarity with computer networking principles
An interest in optics, imaging or photography

This is an on-site role at our Lund campus, as the work is closely tied to our imaging laboratory. No travel is expected.

What Axis has to offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration — whether through informal "fika" chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities.

Check it out:

Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.

Curious to discover more?
We have a host of places where you can learn more about Axis, our products, solutions, company culture, and what working at Axis is really like.

Check out: Life at Axis blog Engineering at Axis blog Innovation at Axis

Ready to act?

Enough said — now it's your turn. Apply through our website; we review applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait until the deadline.

Start date:
by agreement, with early 2027 in mind Reporting to:
Oskar Tynelius, Engineering Manager

For questions about the role, contact recruiting manager Oskar Tynelius at oskar.tynelius@axis.com or +46 46 287 92 96.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

About Axis Communications

About The Role

The Orders team plays an integral role in our organization. As a Senior Backend Engineer
in this core team, you’ll have a significant impact on our overall architecture, technical direction, and company success. Together, we continue to develop one of Sweden’s most widely used delivery services—and you will play a key leadership role in shaping the future of our engineering organization and delivery platforms!

Some of the things you will do

Architect next-generation systems: Lead the technical design, scalability, and performance of our crucial order-handling backbone.
Integrate AI & modern tech: Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools, smart workflows, and modern technologies to enhance system performance, automated processes, and developer workflows.
Drive technical strategy & mentor: Partner closely with product management and cross-functional stakeholders to align technical architecture with business goals while mentoring junior and mid-level team members.
Champion innovation: Stay ahead of industry trends, evaluate new technologies, and introduce best practices that elevate our engineering standards.
System evolution & optimization: Continuously review, audit, and refactor our distributed architecture to maximize reliability, maintainability, and efficiency.
Collaborative leadership: Lead by example in an autonomous environment that embraces pair/mob programming, high-standard code reviews, and collective technical problem-solving.

Your future team

The Orders team is responsible for developing and maintaining the core engine of our business: order handling. This involves everything from creating and managing orders to ensuring their successful completion and everything in between. By driving technical excellence in this domain, you will empower and support development teams across Instabee.

You will join a focused, high-impact team supported by an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, and a Staff Engineer. We operate with high autonomy, relying on senior expertise to make high-leverage architectural decisions foundational to Instabee's growth.

What We're Looking For

Senior Engineering Background: Extensive experience as a Senior Backend Engineer designing, building, and maintaining high-throughput systems in modern production environments.
Core Tech Stack: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript.
Deep Database Experience: Deep expertise with MongoDB (or equivalent document/NoSQL/relational database technologies), including query optimization and schema design for high-scale applications.
Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong proficiency with Kubernetes and production experience with GCP (Google Cloud Platform) or similar cloud infrastructure.
AI Savvy: A forward-thinking, proactive approach to leveraging AI capabilities, LLMs, or developer automation to optimize backend engineering and business operations.
Technical Leadership & Learning: A continuous-learning mindset paired with the ability to drive technical initiatives from conception to delivery.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly articulate complex architectural concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

You don’t need to know every technology in our stack on day one—we value your problem-solving ability, curiosity, and adaptability over checking every single box.

What You’ll Get

We promise you’ll be challenged, rapidly expand your technical reach, and work alongside deeply talented colleagues. If you thrive in high-ownership, adaptable environments and enjoy setting technical direction and best practices, Instabee is the place for you.

Alongside Standard Competitive Benefits, We Offer

🌇 Sky-High Office:
Modern, newly renovated office with a 360-degree view of Stockholm.

🐶 Puppy Friendly:
Bring your dog to work—we have a dedicated floor for our furry friends!

🏓 Fun & Games:
Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and a private Karaoke Room.

👶 Parental Top-Up:
6 months of parental pay support so you can focus on your family.

🎂 Birthday Off:
Enjoy your special day on us with an extra day off every year.

⏰ Flexible Hybrid Setup:
Working hours designed to adapt to your life.

Ready to build the future of logistics with us?

If you're a senior engineer who loves solving complex backend challenges, experimenting with modern tech, and making an impact at scale, we’d love to meet you. Send in your application and let’s start the conversation!

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusion are at the heart of our culture. We are committed to building an inclusive work environment where every perspective is valued and every team member has the opportunity to thrive and reach their full potential.

Get to know us

Founded in 2022 through the merger of Budbee and Instabox, Instabee brings together three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. We serve millions of consumers across Europe with convenient, smart delivery solutions and are on track to become Europe’s leading e-commerce enabler.

As our logistics network and business complexity expand across Scandinavia and continental Europe, we need senior engineering talent ready to architect for scale and build the future with us.

designa lösningar i Azure, AWS eller GCP
arbeta med identitet, åtkomst, OIDC, OAuth2 och IAM
lägga grunden för moderna cloud‑miljöer med DevSecOps i centrum
bygga robusta CI/CD‑flöden och IaC‑lösningar

Cloud Architecture

strategiska vägval kring drift, resiliency och kostnadsoptimering

Kubernetes, containers, serverless och mikroservicelandskap

Team- & leadroller

delivery lead, tech lead eller rådgivande roll mot kund
guidning av team i goda DevSecOps‑praktiker
utbildning och coachning i cloud, säkerhet och moderna arbetsmetoder

gillar att samarbeta och kommunicera tydligt
är trygg i komplexa miljöer och gillar att lösa problem tillsammans
har en bas i utveckling och känner dig bekväm nära koden
värderar kvalitet, struktur och långsiktighet
är inkluderande, prestigelös och uppskattar en miljö där alla får bidra
vill fortsätta lära dig — gärna inom AI, agentic programming eller nya plattformsmönster

Hos oss behöver du inte passa in i en mall. Vi tror på olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och perspektiv - och vi vill att du ska kunna växa på ditt sätt.

affärskritiska – där säkerhet och tillgänglighet är avgörande
långsiktiga – med tid att bygga lösningar som håller
moderna – med cloud‑, AI‑ och DevSecOps‑teknik i frontlinjen
stabila – med erfarna team och nöjda kunder

kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och certifieringar
en kultur av kunskapsdelning, trygghet och gemenskap
interna kompetensdagar, tekniska forum och föreläsningsmöjligheter
erfarna kollegor som gärna stöttar och delar sin expertis
möjlighet att forma både teknik och arbetssätt i uppdrag

Här får du vara både tekniskt vass och mänskligt nyfiken - vi tror att kombinationen behövs för att skapa framtidens säkra digitala lösningar.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect - D365 Business Central
jobs.description:
Full Time Permanent Role

Citywest office, Dublin Ireland /Stockley Park office, London, England

The Role

Uniphar are embarking on an ambitious, multi-year transformation program and are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to own the architecture of Dynamics 365 Business Central, the ERP platform underpinning our Medtech division. Business Central is live and running the division's core finance, supply chain and distribution operations; this senior role holds accountability for the end-to-end technical design of the platform as it scales to support growth, new entities and acquisitions across multiple geographies. The ideal candidate combines deep, hands-on Business Central and AL extension expertise with the architectural judgement to design for resiliency, performance, integration and security in a regulated, medical device environment. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable holding an implementation partner to account on a solution design, sitting with the business to uncover the next opportunity, and getting into the detail to make a change themselves. Working within an Agile, product-based delivery model, the Architect will set the technical direction, own the key design decisions, drive down technical debt, and lead a high-performing development team - ensuring we build the right things, in the right way.

Key Responsibilities

ERP Solution Architecture (Ownership)

Own the end-to-end architecture of Dynamics 365 Business Central as the ERP platform for Uniphar's Medtech division, from target state through to delivered design.
Define and maintain the target architecture, design principles and standards that govern how Business Central is configured, extended and integrated.
Act as the design authority for the ERP platform, making the key design decisions and reviewing and approving solution designs to ensure architectural integrity.
Own the technical debt agenda, moving the platform away from customisation-heavy patterns towards supportable, upgrade-safe design.
Balance business need, cost, time-to-value and long-term maintainability in every architectural decision.
Operate comfortably at both altitudes: setting enterprise-level direction one day and getting into the detail of a posting routine, page extension or permission set the next.

Vendor & Partner Design Assurance

Review, robustly challenge and approve solution designs produced by implementation partners, ISVs and third-party developers, rather than accepting them at face value.
Hold vendors to account on design quality, cost, effort estimates and supportability, ensuring proposed solutions are proportionate, upgrade-safe and genuinely fit for Uniphar's needs.
Ensure partner-delivered work meets Uniphar architecture, security, ALM and coding standards before it is accepted into the estate.
Build open, constructive relationships with partners while retaining design authority and architectural ownership in-house.

Business Partnering & Opportunity Identification

Get close to how the business actually operates, spending time with finance, supply chain, warehouse and commercial teams to understand their processes and pain points.
Proactively uncover opportunities where Business Central and the wider Microsoft stack can remove manual effort, reduce cost, improve control or unlock new capability.
Translate those opportunities into practical, well-sized proposals with a clear articulation of the value, effort and risk involved.
Challenge stated requirements to get to the underlying business need, and steer the business away from solutions that create long-term cost or complexity.

Core ERP Process Architecture

Own the solution design across the core ERP process areas: finance, purchasing, inventory and warehouse management, distribution and order-to-cash.
Ensure the design supports medical device distribution, including lot and serial traceability, expiry control, UDI and consignment / field inventory models.
Work with process owners to standardise ways of working across legal entities and geographies, minimising divergence and one-off design.
Design for master data integrity across items, customers, suppliers and the chart of accounts, and define how master data is governed across the estate.

Designing for Resiliency & Non-Functional Requirements

Design for resiliency, scalability, performance, availability and disaster recovery, ensuring non-functional requirements are captured and baked into every design.
Ensure the platform performs at scale under high transaction volumes across order capture, picking, invoicing and period-end processing.
Embed security, data protection and governance by design, implementing appropriate access controls, segregation of duties and governance policies across the platform.
Conduct architectural assessments of the existing solution and proactively drive improvements to performance, reliability and efficiency.
Own the approach to Microsoft's continuous release cycle, keeping the platform current and upgrade-ready with minimal disruption to the business.

Integration Architecture

Design robust, secure and scalable integrations between Business Central and the wider enterprise estate (e.g. Dynamics 365 CE, Azure, SAP, EDI, 3PL / warehouse systems, Microsoft 365 and third-party SaaS).
Select the right integration patterns and technologies (e.g. Azure Integration Services, Logic Apps, APIs, Dataverse) for each scenario.
Ensure integrations are resilient, observable and maintainable, with clear contracts, idempotency and robust error handling.
Define how transactional and master data flows to the group data platform to support reporting and analytics.

Quality, Compliance & Validation

Ensure the architecture supports the regulatory obligations of a medical device business, including data integrity, audit trail, traceability and data retention.
Design changes so they can be validated efficiently, working with Quality to ensure documentation, testing and change control meet GxP and medical device requirements.
Ensure the platform meets financial control requirements, including segregation of duties and full auditability of financial transactions.

Stakeholder Management

Engage senior stakeholders across the Medtech division and group functions (finance, supply chain, quality and technology) to understand needs and priorities and ensure the ERP architecture aligns to strategic outcomes.
Communicate architecture, options and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Evangelise the art of the possible with Business Central and the Power Platform.

Key Skills, Experiences & Competencies

Deep, demonstrable experience architecting Dynamics 365 Business Central (or Dynamics NAV, with the upgrade path to Business Central) solutions at enterprise scale, ideally multi-entity and multi-country.
Strong functional grounding across the core ERP process areas: finance, purchasing, inventory and warehouse management, distribution and order-to-cash.
Comfortable working at every altitude, from enterprise architecture and design authority through to making straightforward configuration and code changes personally.
Hands-on AL extension development background (extensions, events / interfaces, custom APIs), underpinning credible, hands-on design leadership.
Sound judgement on when to configure, when to extend and when to buy, with a track record of keeping the core clean and upgrade-safe.
Strong knowledge of the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) and sound judgement on where to apply low-code versus coded solutions.
Proven experience designing for resiliency, scalability, performance and disaster recovery (non-functional requirements), including high-volume transactional workloads.
Strong integration architecture experience across Azure (e.g. Logic Apps, Azure Integration Services, APIs); experience with EDI, 3PL / warehouse and SAP integration an advantage.
Experience with ALM / CI-CD and source control for Business Central (e.g. Azure DevOps, Git for Enterprise); manual deployment to test and production environments is not permitted.
In-depth understanding of security best practices, access controls, segregation of duties and governance for cloud and ERP environments.
Experience working in an Agile, product-based delivery environment, supporting a Product Owner and roadmap.
Proven experience managing, mentoring and leading developers and setting the technical quality bar for a high-performing team.
Ability to design innovative, re-usable solutions and components.
Proven ability to analyse complex technical issues and provide effective solutions.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to influence, challenge and build trust at all levels, internally and with third parties.
Experience in a regulated / GxP environment, ideally medical device or pharmaceutical distribution, including validation and change control.

Uniphar Background

Uniphar Group is a rapidly expanding diversified healthcare services business with a global footprint and a proud heritage in Ireland. Since Uniphar became a publicly listed company in 2019, the Group has grown organically and through a series of strategic acquisitions, which continue to strengthen Uniphar’s international reach. With a workforce of more than 3,000 spread across Ireland, United Kingdom, Mainland Europe, MENA and the USA, Uniphar is a trusted global partner to pharma and medtech manufacturers, working to improve patient access to medicines and treatments around the world.

Uniphar provides outsourced and specialised services to its clients, leveraging the strong relationships with 200+ of the world’s best known pharmaco-medical manufacturers across multiple geographies, enabled by our cutting-edge digital technology and our expert teams. Uniphar is organised into three key divisions: Uniphar Supply Chain & Retail, Uniphar Medtech and Uniphar Pharma

Please note that Uniphar is an equal-opportunity employer; we do not discriminate and welcome all responses.

Job Description

As an Associate Software Engineer, you will join our Drilling Fluid Automation team and contribute to the engineering and delivery of software and automation solutions for complex drilling-fluid applications.

Your work will go beyond writing code. You will use engineering drawings, schematics, technical descriptions, and project requirements to develop and program equipment into fully functioning automated process systems. Your responsibilities will span engineering, programming, testing, documentation, and project delivery, giving you exposure to the complete lifecycle of an industrial automation solution.

The role offers an opportunity to develop practical expertise across PLC and HMI/SCADA systems while gaining exposure to broader software technologies and engineering tools. As your knowledge develops, you will have the opportunity to work more independently and take greater responsibility for technical and project deliveries.

About NOV

NOV is a global provider of technology, equipment, and services supporting drilling, energy, marine, and industrial operations. We combine engineering expertise with technology and software to help our customers improve the safety, efficiency, reliability, and performance of their operations.

You will be part of a strong engineering environment, working with drilling-fluid products and the software and automation systems that control this equipment. You will join a close-knit team working together to deliver sophisticated automation solutions for drilling operations.

Why Join Us

Work with automation technology used in some of the world’s most advanced drilling rigs.
Join a collaborative engineering team where knowledge sharing and teamwork are central to successful delivery.
Gain hands-on experience with real industrial automation projects and complex process systems.
Work across different engineering technologies rather than being limited to a single technical area.
Build experience in an international technology company while contributing to real customer projects.

Structured onboarding covering NOV products, engineering tools, Quality Assurance (QA), and Health, Safety and Environment (HSE).
Opportunities to develop expertise in PLC/HMI, software engineering, C++/C#, Qt, process automation, and system architecture.
Exposure to both project delivery and software development activities.
Opportunities to collaborate with different engineering disciplines and, when required, customers.
Increasing technical ownership and project delivery responsibility as your experience develops.
A supportive team environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.

Responsibilities

Develop and program automation solutions for project deliveries.
Program and support PLC and HMI/SCADA systems.
Translate drawings, schematics, and technical requirements into functioning automation solutions.
Test and verify systems to ensure quality and reliability.
Prepare engineering and project documentation.
Contribute to software development and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with other engineers to meet project requirements and delivery schedules.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering or a related field.
Experience with process automation, including PLC and/or HMI systems.
Solid understanding of software development principles and best practices, including design patterns and coding standards.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.
Collaborative and open-minded approach, with a willingness to learn and contribute to the team.
Passion for technology and an interest in keeping up to date with developments in software and automation.

Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.

We Power the Industry that Powers the World

About The Role

At If Insurance, we are scaling Agentic AI into everyday operations to support our employees and customers. Our AIKA Squad, part of the Intelligent Automation Enabler, develops and operates AI agents and agent platforms that help automate business processes across the If organization.

We are now looking for experienced Agentic AI Developers who can combine strong software and AI engineering skills with hands-on experience in the n8n AI workflow automation platform.

In this role, you will develop capabilities for our AIKA Agent platform and build end-to-end AI-enabled workflows with n8n. You will connect agents, business systems, data sources and human decision points into secure, reliable production solutions.

If you are excited about LLMs, agentic systems, workflow automation, enterprise-grade architecture and turning AI into tangible business value, you will feel at home with us.

You Will

Design, build and operate AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, using tools and collaborating with other agents
Build end-to-end AI-enabled workflows using n8n
Develop reusable capabilities and integrations for our AIKA Agent platform
Connect AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, data sources and business processes
Design workflows that integrate deterministic automation, such as RPA, with generative AI and human decision-making
Implement robust evaluation, tracing, monitoring, error handling and safety controls
Apply secure engineering practices to credentials, identities, data access and integrations
Work closely with business teams to take use cases from initial idea to production
Contribute to shared development standards, reusable components and platform governance

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An inclucive work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits
Lunch benefit

About The Team

You’ll be working at the heart of If, collaborating across all If countries, Business Areas, Tribes, and Squads, as well as with the whole IT organization.

Our international Intelligent Automation unit consists of skilled professionals across six locations: Espoo, Turku, Copenhagen, Riga, Vilnius, and Kuala Lumpur. We have already successfully scaled RPA as well as Generative AI assistants across the company and are now on track with Agentic AI journey. We take pride in our supportive culture, modern tooling, and the real opportunities for growth in this high-impact domain.

Who are you?

You are a pragmatic software engineer with a strong interest in Agentic AI and intelligent workflow automation. You enjoy solving complex problems by combining AI models, software components, APIs and business systems into reliable end-to-end solutions.

You balance experimentation with engineering discipline, security and operational reliability. You are comfortable taking ownership, collaborating across organizational boundaries and working hands-on with solutions that run in production.

You do not need to be an AI researcher. We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building dependable systems that create measurable value.

You Have Experience Of

Agent & LLM Development

Designing and building production workflows with n8n
Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI
LLM orchestration (agents, tools, function calling, routing, planners)
Familiarity with evaluation and observability tools for LLM systems

Microsoft & Cloud

Azure AI / MS Foundry
Microsoft Agent Framework (or similar agent frameworks)
Azure services: Functions, App Services, Storage, Key Vault, Event Grid, API Management
Networking, identity and access using Entra ID

Software Engineering

C# (.NET), TypeScript/React, or Python (ideally more than one)
CI/CD with Azure DevOps
Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or Bicep)
Designing reliable cloud-native applications and integrations
MCP-based tool and system integration
LLM supported development tools like GitHub Copilot

Additional facts And The Recruitment Process

Application deadline:
 Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is October 7, 2026.

To apply for the position:
 Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the recruiting system.

Work location:
 Even though the majority of the team is located in Turku, the position is open in Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen, Espoo and Turku.

Travelling:
 Some travelling in the Nordic countries is required.

Start:
 As soon as possible/by agreement.

For more information, please contact Asko Mustonen, Head of Intelligent Automation (asko.mustonen@if.fi)

Background checks will be done in accordance with the law in the country of employment.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Web Platform
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Web Platform team here at Unity. Unity's Web platform lets games and real-time 3D content run in a browser, on any internet connected device. Browser capability has moved fast, browser gaming is going through a revival, and the Unity Web runtime is what makes it possible. Our work also supports an exciting new partnership with a major platform, which puts what this team builds in front of audiences at a scale few browser platforms reach.

In this role, you will own meaningful areas of the runtime outright. This is not website development. We embed Unity inside the browser, and the problems are the deep ones: making a single-threaded platform multi-threaded, cutting megabytes out of a build, getting a game playable in seconds rather than minutes. You will work alongside engineers who helped invent the browser technology we build on, and you will help the people around you grow.

What You'll Be Doing

Own meaningful areas of the Unity Web runtime, from design through to release
Research, design and implement optimizations to the Web build target, such as stripping unused code from builds and progressively loading assets as a game needs them
Improve download size, load and startup performance for Web builds, and set measurable targets for it
Solve uncommon, low-level problems across C++, C# and JavaScript, for example bringing multi-threading to parts of the runtime that are single-threaded today
Partner with teams across Unity who build on the Web platform, translating what they need into platform work
Mentor teammates and help set the bar for code quality across the team
Keep Unity at the frontier of the Web's constantly evolving capabilities

What We're Looking For

Deep, hands-on proficiency with C++ in performance sensitive code
Development experience with WebAssembly, using Emscripten and/or LLVM
Ability to decompose complex technical problems and complete them on your own technical judgment
Experience profiling, debugging and optimizing across the native and browser boundary
Working knowledge of C# and JavaScript
Effective written/verbal communication with peers, managers and key decision makers in other teams
A proven track record of mentoring engineers and raising code quality standards

You might also have

Experience contributing to a browser engine or browser runtime
Deeper domain knowledge of rendering, physics or audio in a real-time 3D engine
Familiarity with compression methodologies and build size reduction

WHO WE ARE

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
