Job Description

Help build the next generation of interactive sports experiences at Trackman.

Trackman is a global leader in sports tracking technology, trusted by professional athletes, coaches, teams, and sports organizations around the world. We are looking for a Unity Developer or Senior Unity Developer who is passionate about building high-quality interactive experiences and wants to help shape the future of our virtual sports products.

You will join a cross-functional team developing a diverse portfolio of interactive applications from family-friendly casual games and skill-based sports experiences to products supporting our growing baseball business.

The role

As a Unity Developer, you will develop and evolve products used by customers around the world. You will work across the full development lifecycle – building new features, supporting multiple platforms, improving performance and contributing to the technical architecture behind our products.

A key focus will be ABS Challenge, our interactive baseball solution supporting challenge and review situations. The product is expanding to additional platforms, including iPad and other mobile devices, and you will play an important role in creating a smooth, performant, and maintainable cross-platform experience.

At the same time, we are modernizing our software architecture across several products and teams. If you have experience with backend systems, APIs or software architecture, you will have the opportunity to contribute to these initiatives and help shape the technology foundation for future Trackman products.

Your key areas of focus

Develop and evolve ABS Challenge, including expansion to new platforms.
Support the development of View, part of our new software architecture.
Contribute to scalable software architecture supporting future products.

What You Will Do

Design, develop and maintain applications and features in Unity and C#.
Develop our portfolio of casual games, skill-based experiences and baseball products.
Bring ABS Challenge to new platforms, including iPad and other mobile devices.
Optimize application performance, stability and usability across platforms.
Develop tools and technical solutions that improve development workflows and team productivity.
Collaborate closely with designers, artists, product owners and developers.
Investigate and solve technical challenges across existing and new products.
Contribute to architecture discussions and engineering best practices.
Support backend integrations and services where relevant.

Job Requirements

What we are looking for

You have professional experience developing applications or games using Unity and C#, combined with a strong understanding of software development principles.

Ideally, You Also Bring

A relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development or similar – or equivalent professional experience.
Experience developing and maintaining products across multiple platforms.
A solid understanding of software architecture, code quality and testing.
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to technical challenges.
A collaborative mindset and an interest in working across disciplines.
Experience in leveraging modern AI tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve quality and support continuous learning.

What You Might Grow Into

As you develop within the role, you'll have opportunities to:

Own larger technical systems and features.
Help shape software architecture and technical direction.
Drive engineering best practices.
Mentor and support other developers.
Expand your expertise in backend services, APIs, and cloud technologies.

Technologies you may work with

Our Technology Landscape Includes

Unity
C#
Cross-platform development and deployment
Windows, Android, iOS/iPadOS and other platforms
GraphQL APIs and backend integrations
Azure DevOps
CI/CD pipelines and automated workflows
Software architecture and design patterns
Performance optimization

Experience with all of these is not required. We are interested in developers with a strong Unity/C# foundation who are motivated to learn and contribute across our technology stack.

An interest in sports, gaming or fitness is a plus, and golf or baseball knowledge is welcome, but certainly not required.

What We Offer

At Trackman, you will have the opportunity to:

Build products used by customers and professional sports organizations around the world.
Work across multiple products and sports, including golf and baseball.
Help shape the future architecture of Trackman's interactive product ecosystem.
Work with talented colleagues across software, design, product, hardware and other disciplines.
Be part of a technology environment spanning sports simulation, radar, computer vision, real-time data and software development.
Grow professionally as Trackman continues to expand globally.

You will also become part of an informal and ambitious culture with plenty of social activities, from Dungeons & Dragons and winter bathing to bouldering, golf tournaments, parties and much more. And, quite possibly, the best lunch in Denmark.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

Avalara is accelerating delivery of AI-enabled capabilities across our compliance platform to improve customer experience, increase engineering velocity, and scale global operations efficiently. As transaction volumes, product complexity, and AI-driven initiatives expand, we require senior engineers who can both deliver high-quality distributed systems and materially increase leverage through applied AI.

This role exists to elevate platform reliability, accelerate AI-enabled product delivery, and raise engineering standards across a globally distributed team. The successful candidate will directly influence delivery speed, system resilience, and AI adoption within engineering workflows and product capabilities.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

This Senior Software Engineer will:

Increase engineering velocity through structured AI-assisted development and automation.
Improve platform reliability, observability, and scalability across distributed systems.
Deliver AI-enabled product capabilities that improve customer efficiency and insight.
Raise team performance standards through technical leadership, mentoring, and strong ownership.
Contribute to a culture of Bar Raisers who improve talent density and execution quality.

This role improves not only output, but how work gets done , embedding AI into development workflows and strengthening architectural discipline.

Responsibilities

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing backend and frontend systems that support Avalara’s global compliance platform.
Increase development efficiency by embedding AI-assisted coding, testing, documentation, and architectural exploration into daily workflows.
Contribute to AI-enabled product features that enhance automation, data processing, and customer-facing intelligence.
Improve deployment frequency, code quality, and automated test coverage through CI/CD and engineering best practices.
Reduce production incidents and improve system observability through thoughtful architecture and proactive monitoring.
Lead technical design discussions and influence architectural decisions for complex distributed systems.
Raise the performance of the team through mentoring, peer feedback, and high standards of ownership and accountability.
Collaborate effectively with global engineering, product, and business stakeholders in English.

12-Month Success Signals

Within The First 12 Months, This Engineer Will

Deliver multiple production-ready features, including at least two AI-enabled capabilities that improve customer or operational outcomes.
Increase engineering velocity through AI-assisted workflows and automation (measurable improvement in cycle time, test coverage, or deployment frequency).
Reduce production defects or incidents through improved architecture and observability.
Demonstrate Bar Raiser impact by mentoring engineers and elevating technical standards across the team.
Contribute to improved system scalability and reliability supporting global transaction growth.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful

Required Qualifications

Must have:
Strong English communication skills (written and spoken) for global collaboration.
4 years of bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in computer science or equivalent Engineering.
5+ years of professional software engineering experience aligned to senior-level scope.
Strong hands-on experience with Java or Python or Node or .NET (C#) building scalable APIs and services.
Flexible to switch between Technology.
Experience with AWS cloud environments.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab).
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production environments.
Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
Strong knowledge of automated testing strategies.
Demonstrated hands-on AI usage that improved measurable business or engineering outcomes.

Nice to have:
Strong experience with React (TypeScript) building maintainable frontend applications will have advantages.
Experience designing and operating distributed systems and RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.

Preferred Experience

Experience in SaaS or enterprise-scale platforms.
Experience in compliance, financial systems, or regulated domains.
Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives.

Bar Raiser Expectations

At Avalara, we hire only Bar Raisers , individuals who improve the average performance of the team.

This Engineer Will

Hold high standards of ownership, quality, and accountability.
Improve the performance of peers through coaching, sharing and example.
Leave systems, processes, and documentation stronger than they found them.

AI Expectations

This role requires applied AI capability, not passive familiarity.

The Successful Candidate Must

Demonstrate measurable impact from AI usage (e.g., reduced cycle time, increased automation, improved quality).
Apply AI responsibly and securely in both engineering workflows and product features.
Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and implement governance-aware best practices.
Share AI techniques and elevate adoption across the team.
Bring new ideas to improve Product and Process using AI.

Casual AI usage is insufficient. AI must materially improve outcomes.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description:
Software Engineer

Despre noi

Suntem un start-up care sprijină SOLOprenorii în drumul lor spre succes. Peste 30.000 de freelanceri, medici, IT-iști și antreprenori români au ales în ultimii 5 ani să își gestioneze PFA-ul cu SOLO, și asta ne face și mai ambițioși. Vrem să ajungem cât mai curând la 100.000 de clienți activi. Misiunea noastră este să transformăm birocrația într-un sistem simplu, digital și automatizat.

Despre ce este rolul?

Construim un produs folosit deja de zeci de mii de oameni și vrem să-l ducem la următorul nivel.

Problema pe care o rezolvăm nu e simplă: legislație complicată, multe excepții și așteptări mari de la utilizatori.

Căutăm un engineer care vrea să contribuie la soluții reale și să crească într-un mediu cu impact direct în produs.

Misiunea ta în acest rol

Vei lucra pe probleme reale ale utilizatorilor noștri , unele bine definite, altele în curs de clarificare
Vei contribui la implementarea și îmbunătățirea sistemelor existente
Vei colabora cu echipa pentru a livra funcționalități în producție
Vei participa la decizii tehnice și vei învăța cum să le iei în timp
Vei folosi AI în workflow-ul tău pentru a crește viteza și calitatea

Ce ne dorim de la tine

2–4 ani experiență în dezvoltare software;
Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);
Experiență cu baze de date relaționale și modelare de date;
Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;
Te folosești de AI (Cursor, Claude, Copilot sau similar) pentru a-ți îmbunătăți modul de lucru și înveți să validezi output-ul.

Ce oferim

Salariu competitiv (în funcție de nivel);
Zile nelimitate de concediu (pe care le și folosim);
Program flexibil;
Abonament premium la clinicile medicale Regina Maria;
Abonament Bookster;
Acces la tool-uri AI (Claude, Cursor, Copilot etc.) și buget de utilizare;
Lucrăm hibrid din București. Poți lucra până la 2 zile pe săptămână de acasă. În perioada de probă, te așteptăm zilnic la birou: e cea mai rapidă cale să înțelegi contextul, să cunoști echipa, și să ajungi să livrezi pe cont propriu.

Despre cum lucrăm în general

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Creșterea continuă și accelerată e ceva fundamental - ne așteptăm de la fiecare coleg să își dorească să se dezvolte și să profite pe deplin de toate resursele pe care le punem la dispoziție pentru învățare. Apoi, ne așteptăm ca fiecare coleg să fie interesat mai ales de rezultat, nu doar de efort în sine.
Clientul este în centrul activității noastre: îi înțelegem nevoia reală, îl tratăm cu empatie și alegem soluții simple și clare pentru el. Facem toate acestea în timp ce ne comportăm cu bunăvoință unii față de alții, oferim și acceptăm feedback și menținem și consolidăm un spirit de echipă în care să ne regăsim cu toții.
Fiind un start-up, ne dorim alături oameni energici, curajosi, autonomi, cu o gândire dincolo de tipare, cu simțul umorului și cu o mare flexibilitate mentală, pentru că adesea realitatea din jur și activitățile noastre de zi cu zi se schimbă din mers în timp ce direcția rămâne clară: suntem aici pentru a sprijini SOLOprenorii.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (SMARTLINK IoT platform)
jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a senior .NET developer who builds that backbone.

You build the platform itself, not the screens in front of it. Your working level is domain models, APIs, messages and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team of 14 people with developers, architects, test engineers and product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.

The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on . NET 10
and C#, with PostgreSQL
for domain data, Apache Kafka
for events, Redis
for caching and ClickHouse
for high-volume telemetry. Services are containerised and run on Kubernetes, brought up locally with .NET Aspire and tested against real dependencies with Testcontainers, shipped through Azure DevOps pipelines and instrumented with OpenTelemetry
.

We are building a new back-end, designed around domain-driven design rather than carried over from what came before. The interesting questions are still open: where the domain boundaries lie, what each service owns, which events carry the truth. You get to answer them, on a fleet that is already global and still growing.

In This Role, You Will

Design and build domain services: bounded contexts, aggregates and a language the business recognises, in cloud-native .NET services that own their own data.
Own your API contracts: design APIs that others build on, version them deliberately, and treat breaking a consumer as a decision rather than an accident.
Design events, not just messages: Avro schemas in a registry, schema evolution, idempotency and replay, and a clear answer for the message that cannot be processed.
Model data for the questions it will be asked: relational design in PostgreSQL where the structure is known, JSONB where it has to stay flexible, and query patterns that still hold when the fleet doubles.
Engineer for fleet scale: hundreds of thousands of devices reporting continuously, where an unbounded consumer or a missing index is not a slow page but an outage.
Make your services observable and operable: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, health checks, and alerts worth being woken up for.
Test your own work, with unit and integration tests next to the product code against containerised dependencies rather than mocks, alongside the test engineers who build our shared framework.
Shape the design upstream and raise the bar around you: turn requirements into a workable domain model during refinement, say so when something cannot be built cleanly, and lead through review and standards people actually follow.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

Several years of hands-on C# and .NET back-end development, at a level where you own a service end to end and design the APIs others build on: contracts, versioning, and the discipline of not breaking your consumers.
A working grasp of domain-driven design: bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
Hands-on with PostgreSQL, including JSONB where the model has to stay flexible, and comfortable writing and reasoning about your own SQL.
Apache Kafka as architecture, not plumbing: producers and consumers, partitions and offsets, schemas and delivery guarantees, and the distributed reality around them - asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency, and the ways they fail in practice.
Container-based, cloud-agnostic development: Kubernetes (AKS / EKS / OpenShift), with containers and pipelines as part of how you build, test and ship.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

Considered a Plus

Designing a domain model or a service landscape from the ground up.
ClickHouse or another columnar time-series store for high-volume telemetry, and Redis at scale.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees’ development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow.

You will benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. As part of the Atlas Copco Group, you will also have access to global career opportunities. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco airpower site in Wilrijk, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.

The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:

Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.

The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.

To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer (ERP)
jobs.description:
About Aderis

Aderis is building the next generation of enterprise software: an AI-native Finance ERP system designed from the ground up to leverage the power of artificial intelligence. We're not retrofitting AI into legacy systems; we're reimagining what enterprise software can be when AI is at its core.We're already live with our first customers and recently secured the funding to scale! This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-moving team at a pivotal moment, shaping the product, the technology stack, and the future of enterprise AI.
The Role

This is a forward-deployed, hands-on technical role at the front line of customer delivery. You'll own the technical side of implementations (data migrations, proof-of-concept setups, integrations, and technical support), working alongside CFO consultants to get customers across Austria, Germany and Switzerland live and successful. You're equally comfortable in a CSV of messy legacy data, an API console, and a conversation with a customer's finance team. You're highly AI-savvy and you reach for automation and scripting by default.
What you'll do

Run data migrations
from customers' legacy finance/ERP systems: profiling, cleaning, mapping, transforming, and loading data, often with inconsistent or messy source formats.
Build proof-of-concept and customer setups
, configuring the platform to fit each customer's processes.
Work heavily at the API level
, integrating Aderis with customers' existing systems using Zapier, scripts, and custom tooling.
Provide technical customer support
during and after implementation.
Use scripting and AI tooling
aggressively to automate repetitive work and accelerate delivery.
Feed technical friction and integration gaps back to Product and Engineering.
Mentor the junior technical consultants and help establish technical delivery standards for the site.

What we're looking for

A working understanding of either finance or ERP systems.
You can speak the language of debits, credits, ledgers, or ERP data models.
Prior experience with ERP systems
such as NetSuite, Odoo, Dynamics, Business Central, or similar.
Very strong technical and AI fluency
: comfortable scripting (e.g. Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar), working with APIs, and using AI tools to solve real problems.
Hands-on experience with data migration and transformation
.
Experience with integration tooling
(Zapier, iPaaS, webhooks, custom integrations).
A self-directed, problem-solving mindset: you figure things out and ship.
Direct customer-facing experience and the communication skills to match.
Languages: German and English

Nice to have

SQL and data-tooling proficiency.
Familiarity with DACH finance/tax frameworks.

Why Aderis

A high-impact, high-autonomy role with direct customer impact.
Modern stack and an AI-first way of working.
Founding-stage site with a clear growth path.
A total compensation in the range of €80-100k (Senior)

SITA For Aircraft is looking for a talented Senior Software Developer to join a strategic modernization program focused on the next generation of Datalink observability, monitoring, provisioning, and configuration management systems.

Based in Barcelona and collaborating with the Montreal engineering team, you will design, build, test, and maintain software applications that transform how Datalink services are monitored, configured, and operated across SITA's global infrastructure.

Working on well-scoped components, you will collaborate with analysts, testers, and software engineers to write high-quality, maintainable code and ensure solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements. The ideal candidate brings solid software development experience, hands-on knowledge of observability tooling, and a drive to apply modern AI-powered techniques to system development challenges

Key Responsibilities

System Software Development

Analyze and identify areas of improvement for legacy system software.
Contribute to the development of new Datalink Monitoring, Observability, Provisioning, and Configuration Management applications.
Write high-quality, maintainable code that meets functional and non-functional requirements and following SITA guidelines, including performance, scalability, and security policies.
Apply AI-powered development tools to improve coding efficiency, code quality, and documentation generation.

Testing & Quality Assurance

Design and perform software tests for Datalink applications, monitor and diagnose performance issues.
Monitor, identify, and correct software defects to maintain fully functioning applications.
Respond to performance issues and contribute to the improvement of system reliability and maintainability.

System Roadmap & Modernization

Contribute to and help maintain the development backlog ensuring work is prioritized in line with business and operational requirements.
Support the modernization of legacy monitoring and configuration management assets while maintaining operational continuity.
Ensure developed components are resilient, scalable, and aligned with long-term system evolution goals.

Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with software engineers, architects, analysts, testers, product managers, and operations teams.
Share information openly, stay in sync with team members, and contribute to a collaborative, ownership-driven team culture.
Promptly communicate relevant updates, risks, and progress with the right level of detail for the audience.

Security, Documentation & Compliance

Implement required security measures and contribute to secure-by-design practices within system development.
Create and maintain technical and user documentation to a high standard; leverage AI tools to support documentation quality and efficiency.
Identify instances of non-compliance with SITA's policies and procedures and report or escalate appropriately.

Qualifications

EXPERIENCE

10+ years experience as a Software Developer, Software Engineer, or equivalent in a professional software development environment, working on large scale real-time and/or critical systems..
Strong software development experience with .NET 8, 10 and C# in Windows environment.
Hands-on experience with container orchestration and modern observability ecosystems in Linux production environment, including Grafana Labs tools such as Alloy, Loki, Mimir (or Prometheus), Grafana, and OpenTelemetry Protocol.
Experience in software integration, configuration management, APIs (REST, SNMP, TCP/IP, UDP), microservices, and backend systems in a distributed systems context.
Solid understanding of software architecture principles, modern programming paradigms, and event-based systems (Kafka).
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international, distributed engineering environment.
Experience writing high-quality, maintainable and testable code, and contributing to code and design reviews. Understanding SOLID and Clean Code principles is an asset.
Hands-on experience with AI-powered development tools for coding assistance, test automation, or documentation generation.
Fluent in professional English

EDUCATION

University Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience. A specific degree is not a prerequisite; equivalent experience and capability are equally valued.

Preferred Experience And Skillset

Experience in aviation, telecommunications, networking, or mission-critical systems.
Knowledge of operational support systems, configuration management, and service management environments such as ServiceNow.
Fluent in professional French

jobs.title: Customer Solutions Engineer (Full Stack / Java)
jobs.description:
ABOUT CARAVELO

Airlines have spent decades selling one trip at a time. At Caravelo, we help them build recurring relationships with their customers instead.

We build the technology behind airline subscription products used by carriers around the world, combining SaaS, payments, booking systems and airline integrations in one platform.

Our Product & Platform teams build the common technology. Our Professional Services team makes it work in the real world for each airline.

That is where this role comes in.

THE MISSION

Caravelo has one platform, but no two airline implementations are exactly the same.

As a Customer Solutions Engineer in our Professional Services team
, your job is to bridge that gap.

You will learn how our core platform can be configured, integrated and extended, and use those capabilities to create the implementation each customer needs — without modifying or forking the core platform.

For every airline, we build a customer plugin
that wraps the specific integrations, extensions, business rules and behaviours required to make Caravelo fit naturally into that customer's technology landscape.

Working closely with Project Managers and customer stakeholders, you will understand requirements, identify the peculiarities of each implementation and decide how best to solve them: configuration, extension, integration or, when justified, a dedicated service or module.

The goal is simple:

Make every customer rollout feel unique while keeping it cleanly built on top of a common, scalable platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Bring customers live

You will be one of the engineers turning a signed customer into a working production implementation.

That means:
Understand customer requirements together with the Project Manager.
Translate business and technical requirements into a concrete implementation.
Configure and extend the Caravelo platform using the capabilities provided by our Product & Platform teams.
Build and maintain the customer plugin that contains customer-specific logic and integrations.
Take implementations through development, testing, launch and production stabilisation.

You'll work closely with our Platform and Product engineers, who will provide the documentation, tooling and training needed to understand the core platform and its extension points.

Your job is not to rebuild what already exists. It is to understand the platform deeply enough to use it intelligently and extend it where necessary.

Solve integration problems

Airlines have complex technology ecosystems.

Some systems are modern. Others have been running successfully for decades.

You will make them work together.

Depending on the customer, you may integrate Caravelo with:
Airline reservation and passenger service systems.
Payment gateways and payment infrastructure.
Identity and authentication platforms.
CRM and communication systems.
Loyalty platforms.
Data platforms.
Internal airline APIs.
Third-party and legacy systems.

Sometimes the solution will be straightforward.

Sometimes the API documentation will be incomplete, the behaviour will differ between environments, or two systems will have fundamentally different assumptions.

You should enjoy figuring those problems out.

Build customer-specific extensions

Most customer needs should be solved using the common platform.

But not all of them will be.

When there is a genuine gap, you may:
Build an additional connector.
Extend an existing workflow.
Create customer-specific business logic.
Develop an isolated service or module.
Implement data transformation or migration processes.

The challenge is knowing when to configure, when to extend and when to build something new.

We want engineers who can solve the customer problem without creating unnecessary complexity.

Own the implementation beyond go-live

Our work does not stop when a customer launches.

Customer systems evolve, vendors change and integrations eventually need to move with them.

You will help:
Investigate and debug production issues.
Maintain customer-specific integrations.
Upgrade connectors as external systems evolve.
Support customers through technical migrations.
Replace or introduce integrations while keeping the service running.
Improve existing implementations when better platform capabilities become available.

For example, an airline may decide to replace its payment gateway.

Your work could involve enabling the new payment connector in Caravelo, adapting the customer plugin, helping define the migration approach for existing payment tokens, validating the transition and supporting the rollout together with the Project Manager and customer team.

These are not theoretical architecture exercises. They are real production systems with real customers behind them.

Work across the stack when needed

Your centre of gravity will be Java and backend engineering.

But customer implementations do not always respect stack boundaries.

You should be comfortable following a feature or problem wherever it goes: backend services, APIs, integrations, databases, scripts, data migrations or occasional frontend changes in Vue.

You do not need to be a frontend specialist.

You do need to be comfortable enough to understand the problem, use AI-assisted development effectively and validate that the result is production-quality.

Use AI as an engineering tool

We actively use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and similar assistants.

You will use them for things like:
Implementation.
Exploring unfamiliar code.
Writing and extending tests.
Debugging.
Refactoring.
Documentation.
Working with APIs and integrations.
Accelerating occasional frontend work.

We are particularly interested in Spec-Driven Development: defining clearly what needs to be built before asking AI to help implement it.

AI should make you faster. It should not replace engineering judgment.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You are succeeding in this role when:
You can take a customer requirement and turn it into a clean, production-ready solution.
Customers launch successfully without unnecessary changes to the core platform.
Customer-specific behaviour remains well isolated and maintainable.
Integrations are observable, reliable and understandable by engineers other than their original author.
You can diagnose complex problems across Caravelo and customer systems.
You understand when to configure the platform, when to extend it and when custom development is genuinely necessary.
You become increasingly independent in understanding new customer technology landscapes.
Migrations and changes to existing integrations can be delivered without destabilising the customer's service.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have:

Strong professional experience building production software in Java, with solid backend engineering fundamentals.
Experience designing and integrating APIs, distributed services and cloud-based systems.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, especially when working across multiple systems or external dependencies.
Good understanding of testing, CI/CD, databases, observability and production software quality.
Comfortable understanding an existing platform and extending it cleanly rather than rebuilding from scratch.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work with Project Managers, engineers and technical customer stakeholders.

Nice to have:
Experience in Professional Services, implementation engineering, solutions engineering or customer-facing technical delivery.
Experience integrating enterprise or legacy systems, particularly in complex customer environments.
Experience with payments, payment gateways, data migrations or other business-critical integrations.
Experience in travel technology, airlines, reservation systems or similarly integration-heavy industries.
Familiarity with the technologies listed in our stack, especially Vue/Nuxt, Couchbase or Datadog.
Experience working in security-, compliance- or reliability-sensitive environments.

OUR STACK

You do not need to arrive knowing every technology we use.

Some of the technologies you may encounter include:

Java · SpringBoot · Vue.js · Nuxt · Couchbase · PostgreSQL · AWS · Datadog · Gitlab · Docker · Opentofu · Claude Code · Cursor

More important than matching every technology is your ability to understand unfamiliar systems, investigate how things work and build reliable solutions around them.

THE KIND OF ENGINEER WHO TENDS TO ENJOY THIS ROLE

This role may be a good fit if you like engineering problems where the answer is not always obvious.

You enjoy understanding how systems behave, not just implementing predefined tickets.

You are comfortable opening documentation for an unfamiliar API, talking through requirements with a Project Manager, tracing a strange production issue across several systems and then writing the code that solves it.

You appreciate good architecture, but you are pragmatic.

And when confronted with a 15-year-old airline system that behaves differently from its documentation, your reaction is closer to “interesting” than “that's someone else's problem.”

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive salary with a clear progression framework.
Flexible working hours.
Barcelona-based hybrid model: 4 days in the office and 1 day working from home.
Tax-efficient benefits including private health insurance, restaurant and transport cards, and kindergarten support.
Budget for training and conferences.
Regular company events and celebrations.
23 days of annual leave.
Exposure to complex airline technology environments around the world.
The opportunity to work across software engineering, integrations and real customer implementations.
Meaningful ownership: you will see the systems you build go from requirements to production.

INTERESTED?

If you enjoy solving complex integration problems, getting customers live and making different systems work together without turning every implementation into a one-off project, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply and tell us about a difficult integration, migration or production problem you've solved.

Porto, Portugal

Hybrid

What will you do as Solution Architect:

As a Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in shaping our organization’s technology landscape. You’ll collaborate with line-of-business stakeholders, assess existing solutions, and design future-state architectures. Your strategic insights will drive business process improvements and enable the adoption of cutting-edge technologies.

Designing System Architecture:

Developing concepts and designs for IT system architecture to meet business, performance, and security requirements.
Defining the structure of applications to be created or modified within a project.
Designing the integration methods between different IT systems.
Creating the initial system architecture as a starting point for further work.
Improving and optimizing existing system architecture in response to changing needs, including evaluating the current state of solutions and identifying gaps.
Designing database architecture.
Creating prototypes and solution skeletons, including recommending and developing design patterns and architectural standards.
Defining principles related to the software development process.
Designing systems in monolithic or distributed architecture.
Developing recommendations regarding specific system solutions, including for commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and self-developed software.

Creating Solution Specifications:

Translating business and functional requirements into a technical design for the future system.
Defining detailed technical requirements for projects, including hardware environment, infrastructure, necessary software, selection of tools, and technologies.
Preparing project specifications and specifications for the technical environments needed for its implementation.

Developing Technical Documentation:

Creating conceptual and design documentation describing the system's architecture and operation, following the ISS Standards.
Preparing descriptions of the system's construction (design) solutions.
Documenting the technical parameters of the system.
Creating schemas, diagrams (e.g., UML), and technical drawings illustrating the architecture, data flow, or component operation.
Developing and updating procedures related to the designed system or architecture.
Describing the non-functional properties of the product/system resulting from the adopted architecture.
Defining the conditions of use and limitations for the designed solution.

Key qualifications:

Holds a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Systems Analysis, or a related field, or possesses equivalent practical experience.
Has 5 -10 years of professional IT experience, demonstrating the ability to think strategically and translate plans into operational excellence.
Possesses deep expertise and preferably some business knowledge in specific domains.
Experience with Cloud native development (preferably AWS/Azure), microservices, APIs (REST/GraphQL), OAuth/SAML and Patterns (e.g. event-driven, messaging).
Knowledge of various Integration patterns and IT Security best practices (OWASP) is a must.

About The American International University

American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs in Engineering and Computing, Architecture and Design, Business, Arts and Sciences, and Education. The programs are delivered in English and follow the American model of higher education. AIU serves a community of more than 4,000 students and is implementing the RISE Strategy 2026–2030, a five-year institutional transformation strategy anchored in research development, international accreditation, student success, employability, and community engagement.

Job Summary

The Application Developer is responsible for developing, enhancing, and supporting custom and enterprise applications at the American International University (AIU). This role focuses on building reliable, secure, and user-friendly software solutions that support academic operations, administrative processes, and student services. The Application Developer works with senior Application Developer and project managers to translate requirements into effective application solutions.

Role Impact

This role supports AIU’s academic and operational objectives by delivering stable, well-functioning applications that improve efficiency, usability, and system reliability.

Key Responsibilities

Application Development & Support

Develop, test, and maintain applications according to defined requirements and standards.
Support enhancements and bug fixes for existing systems.
Follow secure coding practices and development guidelines.

Systems Integration & Enhancement

Assist in integrating applications with enterprise systems such as SIS, LMS, CRM, and analytics platforms.
Participate in application enhancements, automation, and optimization initiatives.
Ensure solutions align with approved technical and architectural standards.

Collaboration & Requirements Support

Work with stakeholders and project teams to understand functional requirements.
Support the translation of business needs into technical tasks and solutions.
Participate in testing, user acceptance, and deployment activities.

Issue Resolution & Maintenance

Troubleshoot application issues and support production incidents as needed.
Assist in root cause analysis and resolution of system defects.
Support post-deployment stabilization and maintenance activities.

Documentation & Compliance

Maintain technical documentation, including design specifications and deployment procedures.
Ensure applications comply with security, data protection, and institutional policies.
Support audits, reviews, and compliance activities as required.

Key Competencies

Application development and problem-solving skills
Understanding of databases, APIs, and web technologies
Ability to follow standards and develop best practices
Strong teamwork and communication skills
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies

Additional Responsibilities

Developing and enhancing Dashboard (Power Bi or Tableau)

Previous experience with Power BI or Tableau would be an advantage but is not mandatory. Training and guidance will be provided when required. Developing mobile versions of existing PHP web applications using the same backend systems, databases, and APIs.
Integrating artificial intelligence capabilities into existing web and mobile applications.
Supporting privately hosted AI models and local large language model solutions while maintaining institutional data privacy and controlling operational costs.

Previous experience in mobile development or artificial intelligence would be an advantage but is not mandatory. These responsibilities will be introduced gradually based on institutional requirements, the candidate’s learning progress, and available training and guidance.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Expertise in PHP, Laravel, SQL/MySQL, AWS, and GitHub version control.
Relevant certifications in PHP, Laravel, cloud platforms (AWS), or web application development are preferred.

Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on our website and submit a resume and cover letter via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Enterprise Integration Lead - 12-Month FTC
UAE · on-site

About the opportunity

Our client is a well-funded UAE technology organisation that takes advanced, research-grade technology into real-world deployment. They are hiring an Enterprise Integration Lead to own the hands-on implementation of an enterprise Facility Management platform that brings together Facilio, BIM and Digital Twin applications, SAP S/4HANA, IoT/Kepware and corporate identity systems into one production-grade whole.

This is a builder's role, not an oversight one. You will take the solution from on-premise deployment through infrastructure configuration, SSO and identity integration, API-based system integration, Digital Twin integration, security hardening and troubleshooting, all the way to production handover. If you like being the person who makes complex enterprise systems actually talk to each other and go live cleanly, this is for you.

Fixed-term, 12 months

What you will do
Deploy and configure the Facility Management solution on customer on-premise servers and VMs, covering application, database, network, SSL/TLS and environment configuration.
Stand up enterprise SSO with SAML 2.0, ADFS/Entra ID and OAuth/OpenID Connect, including user claims and role mapping.
Build, configure and troubleshoot REST API and Webhook integrations across SAP S/4HANA, BIM/Digital Twin, IoT/Kepware and other enterprise systems.
Deliver Digital Twin and BIM integration: asset-to-BIM object mapping, metadata synchronization, iframe integration and live operational data visualization.
Integrate IoT equipment and sensor data using Kepware, OPC UA, MQTT and REST interfaces.
Configure and troubleshoot DNS, firewall rules, reverse proxy, load balancers, certificates and application connectivity.
Run API, integration, deployment and security testing, analyse logs and resolve application, network, authentication and integration issues.
Support SIT, UAT, production deployment, go-live and hypercare.
Partner with customer IT, cybersecurity, SAP, BIM and infrastructure teams to land the platform.

What you will bring
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering or a related technical discipline.
At least 5 years in enterprise application deployment, system integration or technical implementation.
Hands-on on-premise deployment experience on Linux/Ubuntu and/or Windows Server.
Strong command of REST APIs, JSON, XML, Webhooks, Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI.
Practical SSO and identity integration experience, ideally SAML 2.0, ADFS/Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 or OpenID Connect.
Solid networking and security fundamentals: DNS, firewall rules, SSL/TLS certificates, reverse proxy, load balancing and RBAC.
Working knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MS SQL Server.
Track record supporting system integration testing, UAT, production deployment, troubleshooting and go-live.
Clear technical documentation skills across deployment, integration, configuration and handover.
Strong communication and the ability to coordinate across customer IT, infrastructure, cybersecurity, application and integration teams.

Bonus points for
Facility Management, CAFM, IWMS, CMMS or EAM platforms, ideally Facilio.
Strong Linux/Ubuntu, Docker and Kubernetes for on-premise deployment, plus Helm, Kubernetes networking, Ingress, persistent storage, Secrets, RBAC, scaling and troubleshooting.
Unity, BIM/Digital Twin integration, IFC/Revit models, asset mapping and 3D visualization.
SAP S/4HANA and enterprise API integration.
Kepware, OPC UA, MQTT and IoT integration.
SSL/TLS, reverse proxy, load balancers, HA/DR, monitoring, backup and production support.

Why apply
You will work at the point where advanced technology meets real deployment in one of the safest and most liveable cities in the world, on a complex, high-visibility integration you own end to end and take all the way to go-live. Tax-free package.

Interested? Apply in confidence.

jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you will design and build next-generation applications powered by AI agents on the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. You'll own features end-to-end, from responsive front-end experiences to scalable back-end services and agent orchestration layers, building applications for, driven by, and consumed by AI agents - combining strong full stack fundamentals with cutting-edge agentic AI development.

Please note that this is a hybrid role, requiring office attendance at least twice a week.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and build full stack, production-grade applications based on AI agents and multi-agent architectures.
Develop modern, responsive web UIs supporting conversational experiences, real-time streaming agent responses, and dashboards for monitoring agents.
Build robust back-end services and APIs (REST, gRPC, MCP) in Python (FastAPI), enabling agent-to-agent and agent-to-system communication.
Develop agentic workflows using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain/LangGraph, or Azure AI Agent Service.
Integrate LLMs via Azure OpenAI Service, including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, and RAG pipelines.
Design chunking and indexing strategies for RAG pipelines (semantic chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking) to optimize retrieval quality.
Build and maintain evaluation pipelines for LLM/agent outputs (e.g., RAGAS, promptfoo, or custom eval frameworks) to measure accuracy, relevance, and reliability.
Design cloud-native solutions using Azure Functions, AKS, Container Apps, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Search, including data models across SQL and NoSQL stores.
Implement secure, observable, cost-optimized systems using Azure Monitor, Key Vault, Entra ID, and CI/CD pipelines with infrastructure-as-code.

REQUIREMENTS

8+ years of full stack engineering experience, with at least 3 years on the Azure stack.
Strong back-end skills in Python, with a solid grasp of distributed systems and microservices.
Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs and agent frameworks (Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangGraph, or similar).
Strong front-end proficiency in modern frameworks, typed JavaScript, semantic HTML/CSS, and responsive, accessible UI design.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and vector databases (Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB vector search).
Proven experience with RAG architectures, embeddings, chunking/indexing strategies, prompt orchestration, and tool/function calling.
Hands-on experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM/agent outputs and defining quality metrics for AI systems.
Experience designing end-to-end agentic solution architectures (multi-agent orchestration, tool/agent boundaries, error-handling and fallback strategies).
Experience building real-time features (WebSockets, SignalR, SSE) for streaming AI/agent responses.
Solid understanding of authentication/authorization (OAuth2, Entra ID) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, IaC, Docker/Kubernetes).

SoftServe is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, citizenship, disability, health condition, marital or family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

new_jobs.title: Engineering Compliance and CSV Manager
new_jobs.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS, and we're looking for someone to take the role of Engineering Compliance Manager and CSV & Process Validation Manager
in our medical device team.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering physicians globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this position be exciting for you?

At AMBOSS, we build tools that help doctors and students make critical decisions impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. This position makes sure that our product is built, verified, and documented in a way that's compliant, trustworthy, and audit-ready. You'll work closely with engineering as an independent evaluator, setting the standard for what "done and compliant" means across our medical device software. Join a small, high-impact team ensuring our medical device software meets the regulatory standards needed to safely support healthcare professionals.

You Will

As CSV & Process Validation Manager, prove our systems and processes work and produce reliable evidence.

Own the computer system validation and process validation processes for the AMBOSS medical device portfolio — procedures, templates and work instructions — keeping them aligned with MDR and ISO 13485 and updated based on audit findings and team feedback.
Maintain the inventory of systems in scope and decide, risk-based, which need validation and to what depth; plan, execute and document that validation and keep systems in a validated state as they change.
Concentrate validation effort where the evidence is produced — test management, defect tracking, build/release tooling and automated pipeline steps whose output can't be fully verified by inspection alone — confirming these systems and processes reliably produce trustworthy, intended results.
Own the resulting evidence and represent it directly to auditors and regulators; raise, document and own validation deviations and the associated CAPAs through to resolution.

As Engineering Compliance Manager, ensure the medical device product itself is built compliantly, from a day-to-day engineering work perspective

Own compliant execution of the software lifecycle — requirements, design, implementation, verification, release — against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1
Define the compliance requirements and gates in our delivery pipeline against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 (traceability tagging, release criteria, automated checks) and partner with engineering to implement them.
Operate the compliance gate in the release flow, keeping the trace intact from user requirement through verification to released evidence. Sign off each release as a required gate; no release ships without your approval.
Ensure engineering-related Technical Documentation deliverables are compliant with regulatory and QMS requirements
Onboard and train software engineers on compliance requirements and how to work within them day-to-day.
Act as the point of contact for audits and technical reviews on engineering-related topics, representing the team's compliance posture to auditors and Notified Body reviewers.
Drive resolution of audit findings and deficiencies affecting engineering.
Assess the engineering impact of Design Changes before they are implemented.
Identify and drive adoption of tooling the team is missing to work compliantly — both inside the QMS and on the engineering side.

You Bring

Knowledge of medical devices or another regulated industry (pharma, biotech, IVD). Experience in, or eagerness to learn, computer system validation and/or process validation, including risk-based scoping of validation effort, is a plus.
Working knowledge of MDR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 as they apply to software.
Familiarity with software engineering, and enough depth in our stack (React, Python, PHP, Go; AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, ArgoCD) to review pipelines, tests and release processes with engineers as a peer.
Experience representing validation documentation and rationale to auditors and inspectors.
Experience assessing the engineering/technical impact of Design Changes within a regulated development process.
Excellent written and spoken English

You Enjoy

Working closely with engineers, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs — able to challenge and be challenged on technical detail.
Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to explain complex validation requirements to cross-functional stakeholders
Structured, detail-oriented way of working, with the ability to balance regulatory rigor with practical, workable processes for development teams

Benefits

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized, and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health and work-life harmony.

Check out all of our employee benefits here: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That's why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone — regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity — is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfill our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care.

Even if you don't meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to hear from you!

You build and own the software that runs a regulated financial services company — from customer-facing platforms to the tools our team uses every day — and you lead how we put AI to work. Senior role in Munich, reporting to management.

Tasks
